name.zh: Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证

description.zh: Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Kerberoasting Single-Account Exposure Validation preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Kerberoasting Single-Account Exposure Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.en: Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 确认 Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证 的版本与授权边界
title.en: Confirm Version and Authorization for Kerberoasting Single-Account Exposure Validation

description.zh: 记录 Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证 的实验对象、执行主体、系统或域版本、补丁、正常配置和停止条件，确认真实前置条件。
description.en: Record the lab object, execution principal, system or domain version, patches, normal configuration, and stop conditions for Kerberoasting Single-Account Exposure Validation and confirm the actual prerequisites.

title.zh: 运行一条 Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证 已审查命令
title.en: Run One Reviewed Kerberoasting Single-Account Exposure Validation Command

description.zh: 在隔离实验中只运行第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态；涉及写入或远程动作时严格遵守单目标授权。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed command in the isolated lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state; any write or remote action must stay within the one-target authorization.

title.zh: 关联 Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证 的控制面证据
title.en: Correlate Control-Plane Evidence for Kerberoasting Single-Account Exposure Validation

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the Kerberoasting Single-Account Exposure Validation Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证聚焦以下边界：仅对合成服务账号的单个 SPN 核对票据加密类型、密码策略和离线审计边界。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Kerberoasting Single-Account Exposure Validation focuses on this boundary: Reviews ticket encryption, password policy, and offline audit boundaries for one synthetic service account and one SPN. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 凭据风险来自秘密材料、备份权限、缓存、票据或密钥保护边界过宽。有效验证必须区分“对象存在或可列出”与“秘密可被未授权主体读取或使用”，不能把管理员工具成功运行直接等同于漏洞。
vulnerability.en: Credential risk arises when secret material, backup privileges, caches, tickets, or key-protection boundaries are overly broad. A valid validation distinguishes object visibility from unauthorized secret access or use; successful execution of an administrative tool is not itself a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 使用合成账号、离线夹具或只读 ACL 查询建立正常基线，再运行一个 PAYLOADER_CREDENTIAL 标记检查。只保存路径、类型、所有者、权限和事件 ID，不保存口令、哈希、票据、主密钥或明文内容；阳性必须由权限与访问日志共同支持。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use a synthetic account, offline fixture, or read-only ACL query to establish a baseline and then run one PAYLOADER_CREDENTIAL marker check. Retain only paths, types, owners, permissions, and event IDs, never passwords, hashes, tickets, master keys, or plaintext; a positive result requires both permissions and access logs. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 实施分层管理、最小权限、Credential Guard 或等效保护、强服务账号密码与现代 Kerberos 加密，限制备份/调试/复制权限并轮换暴露秘密。对 hive、LSASS、票据、SYSVOL 和凭据 API 访问建立告警，使用合成夹具回归。
mitigation.en: Apply tiered administration, least privilege, Credential Guard or equivalent protection, strong service-account passwords, and modern Kerberos encryption. Restrict backup, debug, and replication rights, rotate exposed secrets, alert on hive, LSASS, ticket, SYSVOL, and credential-API access, and regress with synthetic fixtures.

analysis.zh: NTDS.dit 备份与访问边界审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: NTDS.dit 备份与访问边界审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.en: Record the lab object, execution principal, system or domain version, patches, normal configuration, and stop conditions for NTDS.dit Backup and Access-Boundary Audit and confirm the actual prerequisites.

title.en: Run One Reviewed NTDS.dit Backup and Access-Boundary Audit Command

description.zh: 在隔离实验中只运行第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态；涉及写入或远程动作时严格遵守单目标授权。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed command in the isolated lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state; any write or remote action must stay within the one-target authorization.

title.zh: 关联 NTDS.dit 备份与访问边界审计 的控制面证据
title.en: Correlate Control-Plane Evidence for NTDS.dit Backup and Access-Boundary Audit

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 NTDS.dit 备份与访问边界审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the NTDS.dit Backup and Access-Boundary Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: NTDS.dit 备份与访问边界审计聚焦以下边界：核对域控制器数据库、卷影副本、IFM 与复制权限边界，不复制数据库或提取域凭据。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: NTDS.dit Backup and Access-Boundary Audit focuses on this boundary: Reviews domain-controller database, shadow-copy, IFM, and replication privilege boundaries without copying the database or extracting domain credentials. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 凭据风险来自秘密材料、备份权限、缓存、票据或密钥保护边界过宽。有效验证必须区分“对象存在或可列出”与“秘密可被未授权主体读取或使用”，不能把管理员工具成功运行直接等同于漏洞。
vulnerability.en: Credential risk arises when secret material, backup privileges, caches, tickets, or key-protection boundaries are overly broad. A valid validation distinguishes object visibility from unauthorized secret access or use; successful execution of an administrative tool is not itself a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 使用合成账号、离线夹具或只读 ACL 查询建立正常基线，再运行一个 PAYLOADER_CREDENTIAL 标记检查。只保存路径、类型、所有者、权限和事件 ID，不保存口令、哈希、票据、主密钥或明文内容；阳性必须由权限与访问日志共同支持。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use a synthetic account, offline fixture, or read-only ACL query to establish a baseline and then run one PAYLOADER_CREDENTIAL marker check. Retain only paths, types, owners, permissions, and event IDs, never passwords, hashes, tickets, master keys, or plaintext; a positive result requires both permissions and access logs. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 实施分层管理、最小权限、Credential Guard 或等效保护、强服务账号密码与现代 Kerberos 加密，限制备份/调试/复制权限并轮换暴露秘密。对 hive、LSASS、票据、SYSVOL 和凭据 API 访问建立告警，使用合成夹具回归。
mitigation.en: Apply tiered administration, least privilege, Credential Guard or equivalent protection, strong service-account passwords, and modern Kerberos encryption. Restrict backup, debug, and replication rights, rotate exposed secrets, alert on hive, LSASS, ticket, SYSVOL, and credential-API access, and regress with synthetic fixtures.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 确认 PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证 的版本与授权边界
title.en: Confirm Version and Authorization for PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation

description.zh: 记录 PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证 的实验对象、执行主体、系统或域版本、补丁、正常配置和停止条件，确认真实前置条件。
description.en: Record the lab object, execution principal, system or domain version, patches, normal configuration, and stop conditions for PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation and confirm the actual prerequisites.

title.zh: 运行一条 PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证 已审查命令
title.en: Run One Reviewed PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation Command

description.zh: 在隔离实验中只运行第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态；涉及写入或远程动作时严格遵守单目标授权。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed command in the isolated lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state; any write or remote action must stay within the one-target authorization.

title.zh: 关联 PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证 的控制面证据
title.en: Correlate Control-Plane Evidence for PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证聚焦以下边界：只验证实验主机 445 端口、服务控制管理器 ACL 与日志，不创建服务或执行远程命令。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation focuses on this boundary: Validates only port 445, Service Control Manager AC Ls, and logs on a lab host without creating a service or executing a remote command. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 横向风险来自远程管理协议、认证材料、服务控制、计划任务或会话权限超出分层管理边界。端口开放或管理协议可用只说明能力存在，只有未授权主体可执行远程动作并有目标端日志证明时才构成越权。
vulnerability.en: Lateral risk arises when remote-management protocols, authentication material, service control, scheduled tasks, or session permissions exceed the tiered administration boundary. An open port or available protocol shows capability only; unauthorized remote action plus target-side logs is required to prove an authorization failure.

exploitation.zh: 只对一台隔离实验主机运行 PAYLOADER_LATERAL 可达性、ACL 或事件查询，不传入真实口令、哈希、票据或远程命令。关联源主机、目标主机、防火墙和身份日志，确认协议、账号和授权范围；不创建服务、任务、进程或会话。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Run only a PAYLOADER_LATERAL reachability, ACL, or event query against one isolated lab host without real passwords, hashes, tickets, or remote commands. Correlate source, target, firewall, and identity logs to confirm protocol, account, and authorization scope; do not create services, tasks, processes, or sessions. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 限制远程管理到专用管理网与跳板机，实施主机防火墙、SMB/LDAP 签名、EPA、强认证和分层管理员账号，禁用不需要的 WMI/DCOM/RDP/WinRM。监控远程服务、任务、会话和异常 NTLM/Kerberos 使用。
mitigation.en: Restrict remote management to dedicated management networks and jump hosts; enforce host firewalls, SMB and LDAP signing, EPA, strong authentication, and tiered administrator accounts; disable unneeded WMI, DCOM, RDP, and WinRM; and monitor remote services, tasks, sessions, and anomalous NTLM or Kerberos use.

name.zh: WMI 远程管理授权验证

description.en: WMI Remote-Management Authorization Validation preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: WMI 远程管理授权验证

prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for WMI Remote-Management Authorization Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: NTLM Hash 登录防护验证聚焦以下边界：使用合成认证日志与专用账号核对 NTLM 限制、管理员隔离和远程 UAC，不注入或使用真实哈希。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: NTLM Hash Logon Protection Validation focuses on this boundary: Uses synthetic authentication logs and a dedicated account to review NTLM restrictions, administrator isolation, and remote UAC without injecting or using a real hash. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 横向风险来自远程管理协议、认证材料、服务控制、计划任务或会话权限超出分层管理边界。端口开放或管理协议可用只说明能力存在，只有未授权主体可执行远程动作并有目标端日志证明时才构成越权。
vulnerability.en: Lateral risk arises when remote-management protocols, authentication material, service control, scheduled tasks, or session permissions exceed the tiered administration boundary. An open port or available protocol shows capability only; unauthorized remote action plus target-side logs is required to prove an authorization failure.

exploitation.en: Run only a PAYLOADER_LATERAL reachability, ACL, or event query against one isolated lab host without real passwords, hashes, tickets, or remote commands. Correlate source, target, firewall, and identity logs to confirm protocol, account, and authorization scope; do not create services, tasks, processes, or sessions. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.en: Restrict remote management to dedicated management networks and jump hosts; enforce host firewalls, SMB and LDAP signing, EPA, strong authentication, and tiered administrator accounts; disable unneeded WMI, DCOM, RDP, and WinRM; and monitor remote services, tasks, sessions, and anomalous NTLM or Kerberos use.

Do not modify services, registry, tasks, SUID, sudoers, or processes and do not start a privileged shell. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 应用安全补丁，移除不必要的模拟/备份/调试权限，收紧服务和目录 ACL、sudoers、SUID、安装策略与计划任务，使用受保护服务账户和应用控制。监控高权限子进程、配置变更和异常令牌使用，并用同一查询回归。
mitigation.en: Apply security patches, remove unneeded impersonation, backup, and debug privileges, tighten service and directory ACLs, sudoers, SUID, installer policy, and scheduled tasks, and use protected service accounts plus application control. Monitor privileged child processes, configuration changes, and anomalous token use and replay the same queries.

overview.zh: 注册表启动项持久化审计聚焦以下边界：只读取 Run、RunOnce 和 Winlogon 等批准位置并核对签名与基线，不写入注册表。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Registry Startup Persistence Audit focuses on this boundary: Reads approved Run, Run Once, and Winlogon locations and compares signatures plus baseline without writing the registry. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 持久化风险来自启动项、服务、WMI、账号、票据或模块加载位置允许未批准对象在登录、启动或认证时持续生效。验证应读取配置与事件并和批准基线比较，而不是为了证明风险而创建后门。
vulnerability.en: Persistence risk arises when startup items, services, WMI, accounts, tickets, or module-load locations allow unapproved objects to remain effective at logon, startup, or authentication. Validation should read configuration and events and compare them with an approved baseline rather than creating a backdoor to prove risk.

exploitation.zh: 使用 PAYLOADER_PERSISTENCE 只读查询收集对象名称、路径、签名、所有者、ACL、创建时间和审计事件，限制结果数量并与配置管理清单比较。不创建用户、服务、任务、注册表值、事件订阅或注入模块。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use PAYLOADER_PERSISTENCE read-only queries to collect object name, path, signature, owner, ACL, creation time, and audit event, limit result count, and compare with the configuration inventory. Do not create users, services, tasks, registry values, event subscriptions, or injected modules. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 移除未批准持久化对象，收紧启动位置、服务、WMI、计划任务、账号与目录 ACL，使用代码签名和应用控制，并为创建/修改事件建立告警。对域控实施分层管理、krbtgt 轮换与完整性监控，修复后重复只读基线。
mitigation.en: Remove unapproved persistence objects; tighten startup locations, services, WMI, scheduled tasks, accounts, and directory ACLs; enforce code signing and application control; and alert on create or modify events. Apply tiered administration, krbtgt rotation, and integrity monitoring to domain controllers and replay the read-only baseline.

vulnerability.en: Endpoint risk arises from gaps or integrity failures across script scanning, AMSI, ETW, module signing, process, and command-line telemetry. mitigation.en: Enable and centralize PowerShell, AMSI, ETW, process-creation, and module-load telemetry; enforce application control, code signing, protected processes, and tamper protection; restrict debug and injection rights; update detections; and alert on telemetry gaps, unsigned modules, anomalous parent-child relationships, and memory images.

description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 AD 权限路径只读验证 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the AD Privilege-Path Read-Only Validation Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: AD 权限路径只读验证聚焦以下边界：使用有界图查询和 ACL 读取确认实验主体到高权限组的路径，不写 DACL、改密码或执行 DCSync。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: AD Privilege-Path Read-Only Validation focuses on this boundary: Uses bounded graph queries and ACL reads to validate a lab principal path to privileged groups without writing DACLs, changing passwords, or performing DCSync. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 域风险来自复制、委派、信任、票据、组策略、机器账号或协议补丁边界过宽。有效结论必须绑定精确域、对象、权限、补丁和事件，不能把可读取目录、工具输出或旧 CVE 名称直接拼成通用域管链。
vulnerability.en: Domain risk arises when replication, delegation, trust, ticket, Group Policy, machine-account, or protocol patch boundaries are overly broad. A valid result binds the exact domain, object, permission, patch, and event and does not combine readable directory data, tool output, or old CVE names into a universal domain-admin chain.

exploitation.zh: 使用 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN 对单一实验对象执行有界只读查询，保存 DN、SID、权限 GUID、补丁、协议设置和事件 ID，并与权威目录/补丁基线核对。不写目录属性、改密码、注册域控、复制秘密、请求或注入票据。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use PAYLOADER_DOMAIN bounded read-only queries for one lab object, preserving DN, SID, permission GUID, patch, protocol setting, and event ID and comparing them with authoritative directory and patch baselines. Do not write directory attributes, change passwords, register controllers, replicate secrets, or request or inject tickets. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 实施分层管理和最小目录权限，收紧复制/委派/GPO/机器账号与信任配置，部署供应商补丁与强制模式，使用现代 Kerberos 加密、SMB/LDAP 签名和 EPA。监控敏感属性、复制、票据、机器重命名和域控注册事件。
mitigation.en: Apply tiered administration and least directory privilege; tighten replication, delegation, GPO, machine-account, and trust configuration; deploy vendor patches and enforcement modes; use modern Kerberos encryption, SMB and LDAP signing, and EPA; and monitor sensitive attributes, replication, tickets, machine renames, and controller registration.

description.zh: 记录 DPAPI 保护范围与审计验证 的实验对象、执行主体、系统或域版本、补丁、正常配置和停止条件，确认真实前置条件。
description.en: Record the lab object, execution principal, system or domain version, patches, normal configuration, and stop conditions for DPAPI Protection-Scope and Audit Validation and confirm the actual prerequisites.

title.zh: 运行一条 DPAPI 保护范围与审计验证 已审查命令
title.en: Run One Reviewed DPAPI Protection-Scope and Audit Validation Command

description.zh: 在隔离实验中只运行第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态；涉及写入或远程动作时严格遵守单目标授权。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed command in the isolated lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state; any write or remote action must stay within the one-target authorization.

title.zh: 关联 DPAPI 保护范围与审计验证 的控制面证据
title.en: Correlate Control-Plane Evidence for DPAPI Protection-Scope and Audit Validation

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 DPAPI 保护范围与审计验证 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the DPAPI Protection-Scope and Audit Validation Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: DPAPI 保护范围与审计验证聚焦以下边界：只检查合成用户配置文件中的 DPAPI 元数据、ACL 和主密钥作用域，不解密应用秘密。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: DPAPI Protection-Scope and Audit Validation focuses on this boundary: Checks DPAPI metadata, ACLs, and master-key scope only in a synthetic user profile without decrypting application secrets. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 凭据风险来自秘密材料、备份权限、缓存、票据或密钥保护边界过宽。有效验证必须区分“对象存在或可列出”与“秘密可被未授权主体读取或使用”，不能把管理员工具成功运行直接等同于漏洞。
vulnerability.en: Credential risk arises when secret material, backup privileges, caches, tickets, or key-protection boundaries are overly broad. A valid validation distinguishes object visibility from unauthorized secret access or use; successful execution of an administrative tool is not itself a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 使用合成账号、离线夹具或只读 ACL 查询建立正常基线，再运行一个 PAYLOADER_CREDENTIAL 标记检查。只保存路径、类型、所有者、权限和事件 ID，不保存口令、哈希、票据、主密钥或明文内容；阳性必须由权限与访问日志共同支持。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use a synthetic account, offline fixture, or read-only ACL query to establish a baseline and then run one PAYLOADER_CREDENTIAL marker check. Retain only paths, types, owners, permissions, and event IDs, never passwords, hashes, tickets, master keys, or plaintext; a positive result requires both permissions and access logs. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 实施分层管理、最小权限、Credential Guard 或等效保护、强服务账号密码与现代 Kerberos 加密，限制备份/调试/复制权限并轮换暴露秘密。对 hive、LSASS、票据、SYSVOL 和凭据 API 访问建立告警，使用合成夹具回归。
mitigation.en: Apply tiered administration, least privilege, Credential Guard or equivalent protection, strong service-account passwords, and modern Kerberos encryption. Restrict backup, debug, and replication rights, rotate exposed secrets, alert on hive, LSASS, ticket, SYSVOL, and credential-API access, and regress with synthetic fixtures.

name.zh: RDP 配置与凭据引用审计

description.zh: RDP 配置与凭据引用审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: RDP Configuration and Credential-Reference Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: RDP 配置与凭据引用审计

prerequisites.zh: 确认 RDP 配置与凭据引用审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for RDP Configuration and Credential-Reference Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

description.zh: 仅修正原命令中的纯叙述行或明显实验占位符，保留 RDP 配置与凭据引用审计 技术能力；在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_CREDENTIAL_RDP_CREDS_E_3 与蓝队日志。
description.en: Repair only narrative-only lines or obvious lab placeholders while preserving the RDP Configuration and Credential-Reference Audit capability; run it in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_CREDENTIAL_RDP_CREDS_E_3 with blue-team logs.

analysis.zh: RDP 配置与凭据引用审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: RDP 配置与凭据引用审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

analysis.en: Windows Vault 类型与访问审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。

description.en: Record the lab object, execution principal, system or domain version, patches, normal configuration, and stop conditions for Windows Vault Type and Access Audit and confirm the actual prerequisites.

description.en: Run only the first reviewed command in the isolated lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state; any write or remote action must stay within the one-target authorization.

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 Windows Vault 类型与访问审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the Windows Vault Type and Access Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: Windows Vault 类型与访问审计聚焦以下边界：只检查 Vault 类型、策略和访问事件，不列出凭据值或调用凭据导出功能。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Windows Vault Type and Access Audit focuses on this boundary: Reviews Vault types, policy, and access events without listing credential values or invoking credential export. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 凭据风险来自秘密材料、备份权限、缓存、票据或密钥保护边界过宽。有效验证必须区分“对象存在或可列出”与“秘密可被未授权主体读取或使用”，不能把管理员工具成功运行直接等同于漏洞。
vulnerability.en: Credential risk arises when secret material, backup privileges, caches, tickets, or key-protection boundaries are overly broad. A valid validation distinguishes object visibility from unauthorized secret access or use; successful execution of an administrative tool is not itself a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 使用合成账号、离线夹具或只读 ACL 查询建立正常基线，再运行一个 PAYLOADER_CREDENTIAL 标记检查。只保存路径、类型、所有者、权限和事件 ID，不保存口令、哈希、票据、主密钥或明文内容；阳性必须由权限与访问日志共同支持。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use a synthetic account, offline fixture, or read-only ACL query to establish a baseline and then run one PAYLOADER_CREDENTIAL marker check. Retain only paths, types, owners, permissions, and event IDs, never passwords, hashes, tickets, master keys, or plaintext; a positive result requires both permissions and access logs. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 实施分层管理、最小权限、Credential Guard 或等效保护、强服务账号密码与现代 Kerberos 加密，限制备份/调试/复制权限并轮换暴露秘密。对 hive、LSASS、票据、SYSVOL 和凭据 API 访问建立告警，使用合成夹具回归。
mitigation.en: Apply tiered administration, least privilege, Credential Guard or equivalent protection, strong service-account passwords, and modern Kerberos encryption. Restrict backup, debug, and replication rights, rotate exposed secrets, alert on hive, LSASS, ticket, SYSVOL, and credential-API access, and regress with synthetic fixtures.

overview.en: LSA Secrets Storage-Boundary Audit focuses on this boundary: Reviews SECURITY and SYSTEM hive ACLs, backup privileges, and access logs without saving hives or exporting secrets. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 凭据风险来自秘密材料、备份权限、缓存、票据或密钥保护边界过宽。有效验证必须区分“对象存在或可列出”与“秘密可被未授权主体读取或使用”，不能把管理员工具成功运行直接等同于漏洞。
vulnerability.en: Credential risk arises when secret material, backup privileges, caches, tickets, or key-protection boundaries are overly broad. A valid validation distinguishes object visibility from unauthorized secret access or use; successful execution of an administrative tool is not itself a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 使用合成账号、离线夹具或只读 ACL 查询建立正常基线，再运行一个 PAYLOADER_CREDENTIAL 标记检查。只保存路径、类型、所有者、权限和事件 ID，不保存口令、哈希、票据、主密钥或明文内容；阳性必须由权限与访问日志共同支持。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use a synthetic account, offline fixture, or read-only ACL query to establish a baseline and then run one PAYLOADER_CREDENTIAL marker check. Retain only paths, types, owners, permissions, and event IDs, never passwords, hashes, tickets, master keys, or plaintext; a positive result requires both permissions and access logs. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 实施分层管理、最小权限、Credential Guard 或等效保护、强服务账号密码与现代 Kerberos 加密，限制备份/调试/复制权限并轮换暴露秘密。对 hive、LSASS、票据、SYSVOL 和凭据 API 访问建立告警，使用合成夹具回归。
mitigation.en: Apply tiered administration, least privilege, Credential Guard or equivalent protection, strong service-account passwords, and modern Kerberos encryption. Restrict backup, debug, and replication rights, rotate exposed secrets, alert on hive, LSASS, ticket, SYSVOL, and credential-API access, and regress with synthetic fixtures.

overview.en: Safe WinRM Remote-Management Preflight remains an independently reproducible technical-validation card. Original command capability is retained; review only repairs obvious narrative, placeholder, or non-executable fragments and requires isolated authorization, rollback, and blue-team evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 远程管理工具、WinRM/SSH 可达性和帮助输出本身不是漏洞。有效发现需要证明未经批准的身份或网络边界可以执行远程操作，并由服务端授权、主机日志和网络策略共同证实。
vulnerability.en: 远程管理工具、WinRM/SSH 可达性和帮助输出本身不是漏洞。有效发现需要证明未经批准的身份或网络边界可以执行远程操作，并由服务端授权、主机日志和网络策略共同证实。

exploitation.zh: 先确认身份、范围、回滚点和蓝队采集，再按原始命令逐条执行；把能力结果与资产清单、目录配置、网络流量、端点遥测和服务端日志交叉核对。
exploitation.en: Confirm identity, scope, rollback point, and blue-team collection first, then run the retained commands one at a time; correlate capability results with inventory, directory configuration, network traffic, endpoint telemetry, and server logs.

mitigation.zh: 按主机角色限制 SSH、WinRM 和 WinRS 来源，强制密钥或短期凭证、最小权限与分段策略，关闭不需要的远程服务并审计会话。修复后以同一身份和单一实验主机重复预检。
mitigation.en: Restrict SSH, WinRM, and Win RS sources by host role; enforce keys or short-lived credentials, least privilege, and segmentation; disable unneeded services and audit sessions. Repeat the preflight with the same identity and one lab host after remediation.

title.zh: 修复 DCOM 远程激活授权验证 边界并回归

description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: DCOM 远程激活授权验证聚焦以下边界：只读取实验主机 DCOM 激活权限、CLSID 注册和日志，不调用 ShellExecute 或远程 COM 方法。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: DCOM Remote-Activation Authorization Validation focuses on this boundary: Reads DCOM activation permissions, CLSID registration, and logs on a lab host without calling Shell Execute or remote COM methods. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 横向风险来自远程管理协议、认证材料、服务控制、计划任务或会话权限超出分层管理边界。端口开放或管理协议可用只说明能力存在，只有未授权主体可执行远程动作并有目标端日志证明时才构成越权。
vulnerability.en: Lateral risk arises when remote-management protocols, authentication material, service control, scheduled tasks, or session permissions exceed the tiered administration boundary. An open port or available protocol shows capability only; unauthorized remote action plus target-side logs is required to prove an authorization failure.

exploitation.zh: 只对一台隔离实验主机运行 PAYLOADER_LATERAL 可达性、ACL 或事件查询，不传入真实口令、哈希、票据或远程命令。关联源主机、目标主机、防火墙和身份日志，确认协议、账号和授权范围；不创建服务、任务、进程或会话。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Run only a PAYLOADER_LATERAL reachability, ACL, or event query against one isolated lab host without real passwords, hashes, tickets, or remote commands. Correlate source, target, firewall, and identity logs to confirm protocol, account, and authorization scope; do not create services, tasks, processes, or sessions. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 限制远程管理到专用管理网与跳板机，实施主机防火墙、SMB/LDAP 签名、EPA、强认证和分层管理员账号，禁用不需要的 WMI/DCOM/RDP/WinRM。监控远程服务、任务、会话和异常 NTLM/Kerberos 使用。
mitigation.en: Restrict remote management to dedicated management networks and jump hosts; enforce host firewalls, SMB and LDAP signing, EPA, strong authentication, and tiered administrator accounts; disable unneeded WMI, DCOM, RDP, and WinRM; and monitor remote services, tasks, sessions, and anomalous NTLM or Kerberos use.

overview.zh: SSH 横向管理安全预检 保留为可独立复现的技术验证卡。原始命令能力不被删除；审校只处理明显叙述、占位符或不可执行片段，并要求隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据。
overview.en: Safe SSH Lateral-Management Preflight remains an independently reproducible technical-validation card. Original command capability is retained; review only repairs obvious narrative, placeholder, or non-executable fragments and requires isolated authorization, rollback, and blue-team evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 远程管理工具、WinRM/SSH 可达性和帮助输出本身不是漏洞。有效发现需要证明未经批准的身份或网络边界可以执行远程操作，并由服务端授权、主机日志和网络策略共同证实。
vulnerability.en: 远程管理工具、WinRM/SSH 可达性和帮助输出本身不是漏洞。有效发现需要证明未经批准的身份或网络边界可以执行远程操作，并由服务端授权、主机日志和网络策略共同证实。

exploitation.zh: 先确认身份、范围、回滚点和蓝队采集，再按原始命令逐条执行；把能力结果与资产清单、目录配置、网络流量、端点遥测和服务端日志交叉核对。
exploitation.en: Confirm identity, scope, rollback point, and blue-team collection first, then run the retained commands one at a time; correlate capability results with inventory, directory configuration, network traffic, endpoint telemetry, and server logs.

mitigation.zh: 按主机角色限制 SSH、WinRM 和 WinRS 来源，强制密钥或短期凭证、最小权限与分段策略，关闭不需要的远程服务并审计会话。修复后以同一身份和单一实验主机重复预检。
mitigation.en: Restrict SSH, WinRM, and Win RS sources by host role; enforce keys or short-lived credentials, least privilege, and segmentation; disable unneeded services and audit sessions. Repeat the preflight with the same identity and one lab host after remediation.

name.zh: RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计
name.en: RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit

description.zh: RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计
subCategory.en: RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit

prerequisites.zh: 确认 RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

title.zh: 列出会话
title.en: List Session

description.zh: 列出所有用户会话
description.en: Listall Users Session

title.zh: 劫持会话
title.en: Hijacking Session

description.zh: 劫持指定会话
description.en: Run this RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

explanation.en: Connect to the current console session

title.zh: 使用Mimikatz
title.en: Use Mimikatz

description.zh: 使用Mimikatz劫持
description.en: Use Mimikatz Hijacking

analysis.zh: RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 确认 RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计 的版本与授权边界
title.en: Confirm Version and Authorization for RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit

description.zh: 记录 RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计 的实验对象、执行主体、系统或域版本、补丁、正常配置和停止条件，确认真实前置条件。
description.en: Record the lab object, execution principal, system or domain version, patches, normal configuration, and stop conditions for RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit and confirm the actual prerequisites.

title.zh: 运行一条 RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计 已审查命令
title.en: Run One Reviewed RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit Command

description.zh: 在隔离实验中只运行第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态；涉及写入或远程动作时严格遵守单目标授权。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed command in the isolated lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state; any write or remote action must stay within the one-target authorization.

title.zh: 关联 RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计 的控制面证据
title.en: Correlate Control-Plane Evidence for RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计聚焦以下边界：只列出实验会话元数据和授权策略，不运行 tscon 或接管其他会话。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit focuses on this boundary: Lists only lab session metadata and authorization policy without running tscon or taking over another session. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 横向风险来自远程管理协议、认证材料、服务控制、计划任务或会话权限超出分层管理边界。端口开放或管理协议可用只说明能力存在，只有未授权主体可执行远程动作并有目标端日志证明时才构成越权。
vulnerability.en: Lateral risk arises when remote-management protocols, authentication material, service control, scheduled tasks, or session permissions exceed the tiered administration boundary. An open port or available protocol shows capability only; unauthorized remote action plus target-side logs is required to prove an authorization failure.

exploitation.zh: 只对一台隔离实验主机运行 PAYLOADER_LATERAL 可达性、ACL 或事件查询，不传入真实口令、哈希、票据或远程命令。关联源主机、目标主机、防火墙和身份日志，确认协议、账号和授权范围；不创建服务、任务、进程或会话。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Run only a PAYLOADER_LATERAL reachability, ACL, or event query against one isolated lab host without real passwords, hashes, tickets, or remote commands. Correlate source, target, firewall, and identity logs to confirm protocol, account, and authorization scope; do not create services, tasks, processes, or sessions. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 限制远程管理到专用管理网与跳板机，实施主机防火墙、SMB/LDAP 签名、EPA、强认证和分层管理员账号，禁用不需要的 WMI/DCOM/RDP/WinRM。监控远程服务、任务、会话和异常 NTLM/Kerberos 使用。
mitigation.en: Restrict remote management to dedicated management networks and jump hosts; enforce host firewalls, SMB and LDAP signing, EPA, strong authentication, and tiered administrator accounts; disable unneeded WMI, DCOM, RDP, and WinRM; and monitor remote services, tasks, sessions, and anomalous NTLM or Kerberos use.

analysis.zh: Kerberos 票据导入防护审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Kerberos 票据导入防护审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 确认 Kerberos 票据导入防护审计 的版本与授权边界

description.zh: 记录 Kerberos 票据导入防护审计 的实验对象、执行主体、系统或域版本、补丁、正常配置和停止条件，确认真实前置条件。
description.en: Record the lab object, execution principal, system or domain version, patches, normal configuration, and stop conditions for Kerberos Ticket-Import Protection Audit and confirm the actual prerequisites.

title.zh: 运行一条 Kerberos 票据导入防护审计 已审查命令
title.en: Run One Reviewed Kerberos Ticket-Import Protection Audit Command

description.zh: 在隔离实验中只运行第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态；涉及写入或远程动作时严格遵守单目标授权。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed command in the isolated lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state; any write or remote action must stay within the one-target authorization.

title.zh: 关联 Kerberos 票据导入防护审计 的控制面证据
title.en: Correlate Control-Plane Evidence for Kerberos Ticket-Import Protection Audit

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 Kerberos 票据导入防护审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the Kerberos Ticket-Import Protection Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: Kerberos 票据导入防护审计聚焦以下边界：使用离线合成 kirbi 元数据核对票据主体、服务与时效，不把票据导入登录会话。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Kerberos Ticket-Import Protection Audit focuses on this boundary: Uses offline synthetic kirbi metadata to review principal, service, and lifetime without importing a ticket into a logon session. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 横向风险来自远程管理协议、认证材料、服务控制、计划任务或会话权限超出分层管理边界。端口开放或管理协议可用只说明能力存在，只有未授权主体可执行远程动作并有目标端日志证明时才构成越权。
vulnerability.en: Lateral risk arises when remote-management protocols, authentication material, service control, scheduled tasks, or session permissions exceed the tiered administration boundary. An open port or available protocol shows capability only; unauthorized remote action plus target-side logs is required to prove an authorization failure.

exploitation.zh: 只对一台隔离实验主机运行 PAYLOADER_LATERAL 可达性、ACL 或事件查询，不传入真实口令、哈希、票据或远程命令。关联源主机、目标主机、防火墙和身份日志，确认协议、账号和授权范围；不创建服务、任务、进程或会话。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Run only a PAYLOADER_LATERAL reachability, ACL, or event query against one isolated lab host without real passwords, hashes, tickets, or remote commands. Correlate source, target, firewall, and identity logs to confirm protocol, account, and authorization scope; do not create services, tasks, processes, or sessions. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 限制远程管理到专用管理网与跳板机，实施主机防火墙、SMB/LDAP 签名、EPA、强认证和分层管理员账号，禁用不需要的 WMI/DCOM/RDP/WinRM。监控远程服务、任务、会话和异常 NTLM/Kerberos 使用。
mitigation.en: Restrict remote management to dedicated management networks and jump hosts; enforce host firewalls, SMB and LDAP signing, EPA, strong authentication, and tiered administrator accounts; disable unneeded WMI, DCOM, RDP, and WinRM; and monitor remote services, tasks, sessions, and anomalous NTLM or Kerberos use.

overview.zh: 远程计划任务授权验证聚焦以下边界：只读取实验主机计划任务 ACL 与日志，不创建一次性任务或执行远程命令。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Remote Scheduled-Task Authorization Validation focuses on this boundary: Reads scheduled-task ACLs and logs on a lab host without creating one-time tasks or executing a remote command. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 横向风险来自远程管理协议、认证材料、服务控制、计划任务或会话权限超出分层管理边界。端口开放或管理协议可用只说明能力存在，只有未授权主体可执行远程动作并有目标端日志证明时才构成越权。
vulnerability.en: Lateral risk arises when remote-management protocols, authentication material, service control, scheduled tasks, or session permissions exceed the tiered administration boundary. An open port or available protocol shows capability only; unauthorized remote action plus target-side logs is required to prove an authorization failure.

exploitation.zh: 只对一台隔离实验主机运行 PAYLOADER_LATERAL 可达性、ACL 或事件查询，不传入真实口令、哈希、票据或远程命令。关联源主机、目标主机、防火墙和身份日志，确认协议、账号和授权范围；不创建服务、任务、进程或会话。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Run only a PAYLOADER_LATERAL reachability, ACL, or event query against one isolated lab host without real passwords, hashes, tickets, or remote commands. Correlate source, target, firewall, and identity logs to confirm protocol, account, and authorization scope; do not create services, tasks, processes, or sessions. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 限制远程管理到专用管理网与跳板机，实施主机防火墙、SMB/LDAP 签名、EPA、强认证和分层管理员账号，禁用不需要的 WMI/DCOM/RDP/WinRM。监控远程服务、任务、会话和异常 NTLM/Kerberos 使用。
mitigation.en: Restrict remote management to dedicated management networks and jump hosts; enforce host firewalls, SMB and LDAP signing, EPA, strong authentication, and tiered administrator accounts; disable unneeded WMI, DCOM, RDP, and WinRM; and monitor remote services, tasks, sessions, and anomalous NTLM or Kerberos use.

Original command capability is retained; review only repairs obvious narrative, placeholder, or non-executable fragments and requires isolated authorization, rollback, and blue-team evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 远程管理工具、WinRM/SSH 可达性和帮助输出本身不是漏洞。有效发现需要证明未经批准的身份或网络边界可以执行远程操作，并由服务端授权、主机日志和网络策略共同证实。
vulnerability.en: 远程管理工具、WinRM/SSH 可达性和帮助输出本身不是漏洞。有效发现需要证明未经批准的身份或网络边界可以执行远程操作，并由服务端授权、主机日志和网络策略共同证实。

exploitation.zh: 先确认身份、范围、回滚点和蓝队采集，再按原始命令逐条执行；把能力结果与资产清单、目录配置、网络流量、端点遥测和服务端日志交叉核对。
exploitation.en: Confirm identity, scope, rollback point, and blue-team collection first, then run the retained commands one at a time; correlate capability results with inventory, directory configuration, network traffic, endpoint telemetry, and server logs.

mitigation.zh: 按主机角色限制 SSH、WinRM 和 WinRS 来源，强制密钥或短期凭证、最小权限与分段策略，关闭不需要的远程服务并审计会话。修复后以同一身份和单一实验主机重复预检。
mitigation.en: Restrict SSH, WinRM, and Win RS sources by host role; enforce keys or short-lived credentials, least privilege, and segmentation; disable unneeded services and audit sessions. Repeat the preflight with the same identity and one lab host after remediation.

vulnerability.zh: Windows 令牌权限、服务清单或未引用路径只是枚举结果。只有低权限主体能够修改由高权限服务加载的二进制、目录、注册表参数或服务配置，并且重启或触发条件可达时，才形成可利用的提权边界。
vulnerability.en: Windows token privileges, service inventory, and unquoted paths are enumeration results only. An exploitable boundary requires a low-privilege principal to modify a binary, directory, registry argument, or service configuration loaded by a privileged service, with a reachable restart or trigger condition.

exploitation.zh: 先确认身份、范围、回滚点和蓝队采集，再按原始命令逐条执行；把能力结果与资产清单、目录配置、网络流量、端点遥测和服务端日志交叉核对。
exploitation.en: Confirm identity, scope, rollback point, and blue-team collection first, then run the retained commands one at a time; correlate capability results with inventory, directory configuration, network traffic, endpoint telemetry, and server logs.

mitigation.zh: 收紧服务对象、二进制目录和注册表 ACL，引用包含空格的服务路径，移除不必要的令牌权限并使用受管服务账号。修复后以同一低权限主体重复 ACL 与服务基线查询。
mitigation.en: Tighten service-object, binary-directory, and registry ACLs; quote service paths containing spaces; remove unnecessary token privileges; and use managed service identities. Repeat the ACL and service baseline with the same low-privilege principal after remediation.

vulnerability.zh: SUID、sudo、Linux capabilities、Cron 或 systemd 条目本身不是漏洞。只有当前低权限主体可控制高权限程序的可执行文件、参数、环境变量、搜索路径或被加载资源，并能稳定到达高权限执行点时，才构成提权链。
vulnerability.en: SUID files, sudo rules, Linux capabilities, Cron entries, and systemd units are not vulnerabilities by themselves. privilege escalation requires the current low-privilege principal to control a privileged program, argument, environment variable, search path, or loaded resource and reliably reach the privileged execution point.

exploitation.zh: 先确认身份、范围、回滚点和蓝队采集，再按原始命令逐条执行；把能力结果与资产清单、目录配置、网络流量、端点遥测和服务端日志交叉核对。
exploitation.en: Confirm identity, scope, rollback point, and blue-team collection first, then run the retained commands one at a time; correlate capability results with inventory, directory configuration, network traffic, endpoint telemetry, and server logs.

mitigation.zh: 移除非必要 SUID/SGID 与 file capabilities，使用精确 sudo 命令和参数约束，修复 Cron/systemd 文件及父目录所有权，并清理可写 PATH 与动态库搜索路径。修复后以同一 UID/GID 重放只读枚举。
mitigation.en: Remove unnecessary SUID or SGID bits and file capabilities, constrain sudo commands and arguments precisely, correct Cron or systemd file and parent-directory ownership, and remove writable PATH or library-search entries. Replay read-only enumeration with the same UID and GID after remediation.

name.zh: UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计
name.en: UAC Policy and Auto-Elevation Boundary Audit

description.zh: UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: UAC Policy and Auto-Elevation Boundary Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计
subCategory.en: UAC Policy and Auto-Elevation Boundary Audit

prerequisites.zh: 确认 UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for UAC Policy and Auto-Elevation Boundary Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 确认 UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计 的版本与授权边界

description.zh: 记录 UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计 的实验对象、执行主体、系统或域版本、补丁、正常配置和停止条件，确认真实前置条件。
description.en: Record the lab object, execution principal, system or domain version, patches, normal configuration, and stop conditions for UAC Policy and Auto-Elevation Boundary Audit and confirm the actual prerequisites.

title.zh: 运行一条 UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计 已审查命令
title.en: Run One Reviewed UAC Policy and Auto-Elevation Boundary Audit Command

description.zh: 在隔离实验中只运行第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态；涉及写入或远程动作时严格遵守单目标授权。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed command in the isolated lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state; any write or remote action must stay within the one-target authorization.

title.zh: 关联 UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计 的控制面证据
title.en: Correlate Control-Plane Evidence for UAC Policy and Auto-Elevation Boundary Audit

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the UAC Policy and Auto-Elevation Boundary Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计聚焦以下边界：核对 UAC 策略、自动提升二进制和相关注册表 ACL，不写入 shell/open/command 键或启动载荷。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: UAC Policy and Auto-Elevation Boundary Audit focuses on this boundary: Reviews UAC policy, auto-elevated binaries, and relevant registry ACLs without writing shell/open/command keys or launching a payload. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 提权风险来自服务、文件、令牌、安装策略、内核或计划执行边界允许低权限主体影响高权限进程。版本匹配、权限存在或工具可运行只是前置条件，必须证明可控对象与高权限执行之间存在实际授权缺口。
vulnerability.en: Privilege-escalation risk arises when services, files, tokens, installer policy, kernel, or scheduled execution let a low-privilege principal influence a high-privilege process. Version match, privilege presence, or tool availability is only a prerequisite; an actual authorization gap between a controllable object and privileged execution must be shown.

exploitation.zh: 在可回滚实验主机使用 PAYLOADER_PRIVESC 只读查询记录版本、补丁、ACL、所有者、服务账户和令牌权限，并与高权限基线对照。不修改服务、注册表、任务、SUID、sudoers 或进程，也不启动高权限 shell。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use PAYLOADER_PRIVESC read-only queries on a reversible lab host to record version, patches, ACLs, owners, service accounts, and token privileges and compare them with a privileged baseline. Do not modify services, registry, tasks, SUID, sudoers, or processes and do not start a privileged shell. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 应用安全补丁，移除不必要的模拟/备份/调试权限，收紧服务和目录 ACL、sudoers、SUID、安装策略与计划任务，使用受保护服务账户和应用控制。监控高权限子进程、配置变更和异常令牌使用，并用同一查询回归。
mitigation.en: Apply security patches, remove unneeded impersonation, backup, and debug privileges, tighten service and directory ACLs, sudoers, SUID, installer policy, and scheduled tasks, and use protected service accounts plus application control. Monitor privileged child processes, configuration changes, and anomalous token use and replay the same queries.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 确认 Windows 服务 ACL 与路径审计 的版本与授权边界
title.en: Confirm Version and Authorization for Windows Service ACL and Path Audit

description.zh: 记录 Windows 服务 ACL 与路径审计 的实验对象、执行主体、系统或域版本、补丁、正常配置和停止条件，确认真实前置条件。
description.en: Record the lab object, execution principal, system or domain version, patches, normal configuration, and stop conditions for Windows Service ACL and Path Audit and confirm the actual prerequisites.

title.zh: 运行一条 Windows 服务 ACL 与路径审计 已审查命令
title.en: Run One Reviewed Windows Service ACL and Path Audit Command

description.zh: 在隔离实验中只运行第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态；涉及写入或远程动作时严格遵守单目标授权。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed command in the isolated lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state; any write or remote action must stay within the one-target authorization.

title.zh: 关联 Windows 服务 ACL 与路径审计 的控制面证据
title.en: Correlate Control-Plane Evidence for Windows Service ACL and Path Audit

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 Windows 服务 ACL 与路径审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the Windows Service ACL and Path Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: Windows 服务 ACL 与路径审计聚焦以下边界：只读取一个实验服务的二进制路径、启动账户和 ACL，不修改 binPath 或启停服务。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Windows Service ACL and Path Audit focuses on this boundary: Reads binary path, service account, and ACL for one lab service without changing bin Path or starting or stopping the service. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 提权风险来自服务、文件、令牌、安装策略、内核或计划执行边界允许低权限主体影响高权限进程。版本匹配、权限存在或工具可运行只是前置条件，必须证明可控对象与高权限执行之间存在实际授权缺口。
vulnerability.en: Privilege-escalation risk arises when services, files, tokens, installer policy, kernel, or scheduled execution let a low-privilege principal influence a high-privilege process. Version match, privilege presence, or tool availability is only a prerequisite; an actual authorization gap between a controllable object and privileged execution must be shown.

exploitation.zh: 在可回滚实验主机使用 PAYLOADER_PRIVESC 只读查询记录版本、补丁、ACL、所有者、服务账户和令牌权限，并与高权限基线对照。不修改服务、注册表、任务、SUID、sudoers 或进程，也不启动高权限 shell。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use PAYLOADER_PRIVESC read-only queries on a reversible lab host to record version, patches, ACLs, owners, service accounts, and token privileges and compare them with a privileged baseline. Do not modify services, registry, tasks, SUID, sudoers, or processes and do not start a privileged shell. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 应用安全补丁，移除不必要的模拟/备份/调试权限，收紧服务和目录 ACL、sudoers、SUID、安装策略与计划任务，使用受保护服务账户和应用控制。监控高权限子进程、配置变更和异常令牌使用，并用同一查询回归。
mitigation.en: Apply security patches, remove unneeded impersonation, backup, and debug privileges, tighten service and directory ACLs, sudoers, SUID, installer policy, and scheduled tasks, and use protected service accounts plus application control. Monitor privileged child processes, configuration changes, and anomalous token use and replay the same queries.

name.zh: AlwaysInstallElevated 策略审计

description.zh: AlwaysInstallElevated 策略审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: AlwaysInstallElevated Policy Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: AlwaysInstallElevated 策略审计

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

Write-Output "PAYLOADER_PRIVESC_ALWAYS_INSTALL_E_2"

Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 应用安全补丁，移除不必要的模拟/备份/调试权限，收紧服务和目录 ACL、sudoers、SUID、安装策略与计划任务，使用受保护服务账户和应用控制。监控高权限子进程、配置变更和异常令牌使用，并用同一查询回归。
mitigation.en: Apply security patches, remove unneeded impersonation, backup, and debug privileges, tighten service and directory ACLs, sudoers, SUID, installer policy, and scheduled tasks, and use protected service accounts plus application control. Monitor privileged child processes, configuration changes, and anomalous token use and replay the same queries.

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 SUID 文件权限边界审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the SUID File-Permission Boundary Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: SUID 文件权限边界审计聚焦以下边界：在限定系统目录列出 SUID 文件、所有者和哈希，并与批准基线比较，不使用 shell escape。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: SUID File-Permission Boundary Audit focuses on this boundary: Lists SUID files, owners, and hashes in bounded system directories and compares them with an approved baseline without using shell escapes. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 提权风险来自服务、文件、令牌、安装策略、内核或计划执行边界允许低权限主体影响高权限进程。版本匹配、权限存在或工具可运行只是前置条件，必须证明可控对象与高权限执行之间存在实际授权缺口。
vulnerability.en: Privilege-escalation risk arises when services, files, tokens, installer policy, kernel, or scheduled execution let a low-privilege principal influence a high-privilege process. Version match, privilege presence, or tool availability is only a prerequisite; an actual authorization gap between a controllable object and privileged execution must be shown.

exploitation.zh: 在可回滚实验主机使用 PAYLOADER_PRIVESC 只读查询记录版本、补丁、ACL、所有者、服务账户和令牌权限，并与高权限基线对照。不修改服务、注册表、任务、SUID、sudoers 或进程，也不启动高权限 shell。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use PAYLOADER_PRIVESC read-only queries on a reversible lab host to record version, patches, ACLs, owners, service accounts, and token privileges and compare them with a privileged baseline. Do not modify services, registry, tasks, SUID, sudoers, or processes and do not start a privileged shell. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 应用安全补丁，移除不必要的模拟/备份/调试权限，收紧服务和目录 ACL、sudoers、SUID、安装策略与计划任务，使用受保护服务账户和应用控制。监控高权限子进程、配置变更和异常令牌使用，并用同一查询回归。
mitigation.en: Apply security patches, remove unneeded impersonation, backup, and debug privileges, tighten service and directory ACLs, sudoers, SUID, installer policy, and scheduled tasks, and use protected service accounts plus application control. Monitor privileged child processes, configuration changes, and anomalous token use and replay the same queries.

name.zh: Sudoers 最小权限审计
