title.zh: 常见内核漏洞
title.en: common Kernel Exploits

description.zh: 常见内核提权漏洞
description.en: Common kernel privilege escalation vulnerabilities

analysis.zh: 报告必须标明发行版、精确包构建、架构、启动内核、适用公告与前置权限；缺少供应商适用性证据时只能记录待核 CVE。
analysis.en: Reports must identify the distribution, exact package build, architecture, booted kernel, applicable advisory, and prerequisite privileges. Without vendor applicability evidence, record only a CVE requiring review.

opsecTips.zh: 限制查询次数和输出字段，不保存凭证、Token、邮件正文或无关用户属性。
opsecTips.en: Limit query count and output fields, and do not retain credentials, tokens, mail bodies, or unrelated user attributes.

opsecTips.zh: 检测到超出授权的写操作、认证尝试、非授权资产或异常请求量时立即停止、回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on writes, authentication attempts, unauthorized assets, or abnormal request volume outside the authorization.

title.zh: 建立Linux 内核风险只读核对前置条件基线
title.en: Establish the Read-Only Linux Kernel Risk Review Prerequisite Baseline

description.zh: 记录 Linux 内核风险只读核对 的当前主体、单一授权资产、组件或工具版本、适用条件、正常基线和停止条件；不把工具存在或查询成功直接判定为漏洞。
description.en: Record the principal, one authorized asset, component or tool version, applicability conditions, normal baseline, and stop conditions for Read-Only Linux Kernel Risk Review; do not treat tool availability or query success as a vulnerability.

title.zh: 运行一条Linux 内核风险只读核对验证命令
title.en: Run One Read-Only Linux Kernel Risk Review Validation Command

description.zh: 只在授权实验中运行 Linux 内核风险只读核对 的第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态，不串联其他动作。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed Read-Only Linux Kernel Risk Review command in the authorized lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state without chaining other actions.

title.zh: 关联Linux 内核风险只读核对权威证据
title.en: Correlate Authoritative Read-Only Linux Kernel Risk Review Evidence

description.zh: 关联 uname、发行版与内核包版本、供应商公告、启动中的实际内核、关键配置和补丁状态；不得用 Searchsploit 结果或上游版本范围替代发行版适用性判断。
description.en: Correlate uname output, distribution and kernel package versions, vendor advisories, the actually booted kernel, relevant configuration, and patch state. Do not substitute Searchsploit results or upstream version ranges for distribution-specific applicability.

title.zh: 修复并回归Linux 内核风险只读核对
title.en: Remediate and Retest Read-Only Linux Kernel Risk Review

description.zh: 完成 Linux 内核风险只读核对 对应的最小权限、补丁或配置修复后，以相同主体和同一条命令回归，确认正常管理能力保留且原证据链不再成立。
description.en: After the least-privilege, patch, or configuration remediation for Read-Only Linux Kernel Risk Review, retest with the same principal and command to confirm legitimate administration remains available and the original evidence chain no longer holds.

overview.zh: Linux 内核风险只读核对 保留为可独立复现的技术验证卡。原始命令能力不被删除；审校只处理明显叙述、占位符或不可执行片段，并要求隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据。
overview.en: Read-Only Linux Kernel Risk Review remains an independently reproducible technical-validation card. Original command capability is retained; review only repairs obvious narrative, placeholder, or non-executable fragments and requires isolated authorization, rollback, and blue-team evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 内核版本字符串或漏洞扫描器命中不能直接证明可利用。发行版可能回移补丁，实际适用性取决于内核包构建、架构、配置项、命名空间与 LSM、容器边界以及攻击者当前权限。
vulnerability.en: A kernel version string or scanner match does not prove exploitability. Distributions may backport fixes, and applicability depends on the exact kernel package build, architecture, configuration, namespaces and LSMs, container boundary, and the attacker's current privileges.

exploitation.zh: 先确认身份、范围、回滚点和蓝队采集，再按原始命令逐条执行；把能力结果与资产清单、目录配置、网络流量、端点遥测和服务端日志交叉核对。
exploitation.en: Confirm identity, scope, rollback point, and blue-team collection first, then run the retained commands one at a time; correlate capability results with inventory, directory configuration, network traffic, endpoint telemetry, and server logs.

mitigation.zh: 按发行版公告和已安装包版本确认修复状态，升级受支持内核并完成必要重启，禁用不需要的用户命名空间或高风险模块，并监控异常崩溃和提权行为。修复后重新采集同一版本与包基线。
mitigation.en: Use distribution advisories and installed package versions to confirm fix status, upgrade to a supported kernel and reboot when required, disable unnecessary user namespaces or risky modules, and monitor anomalous crashes and elevation. Recollect the same version and package baseline after remediation.

name.zh: WMI 永久事件订阅审计

description.zh: WMI 永久事件订阅审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: WMI Permanent Event-Subscription Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: WMI 永久事件订阅审计

prerequisites.zh: 确认 WMI 永久事件订阅审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for WMI Permanent Event-Subscription Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

title.zh: 创建事件过滤器
title.en: Create Event Filter Tool

execution.command: $filter = New-WmiEventFilter -Name "evil" -Query "SELECT * FROM __InstanceModificationEvent WITHIN 60 WHERE TargetInstance ISA 'Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_System'"

description.zh: 创建WMI事件过滤器
description.en: Create WMI Event Filter Tool

title.zh: WMI 永久事件订阅审计校正命令 2
title.en: WMI Permanent Event-Subscription Audit Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 仅修正原命令中的纯叙述行或明显实验占位符，保留 WMI 永久事件订阅审计 技术能力；在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_PERSISTENCE_PERSISTENCE_WMI_E_2 与蓝队日志。
description.en: Repair only narrative-only lines or obvious lab placeholders while preserving the WMI Permanent Event-Subscription Audit capability; run it in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_PERSISTENCE_PERSISTENCE_WMI_E_2 with blue-team logs.

title.zh: 绑定过滤器和消费者
title.en: Bind the filter to the consumer

description.zh: 绑定触发执行
description.en: binding Trigger Execute

analysis.zh: WMI 永久事件订阅审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: WMI 永久事件订阅审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 确认 WMI 永久事件订阅审计 的版本与授权边界
title.en: Confirm Version and Authorization for WMI Permanent Event-Subscription Audit

description.zh: 记录 WMI 永久事件订阅审计 的实验对象、执行主体、系统或域版本、补丁、正常配置和停止条件，确认真实前置条件。
description.en: Record the lab object, execution principal, system or domain version, patches, normal configuration, and stop conditions for WMI Permanent Event-Subscription Audit and confirm the actual prerequisites.

title.zh: 运行一条 WMI 永久事件订阅审计 已审查命令
title.en: Run One Reviewed WMI Permanent Event-Subscription Audit Command

description.zh: 在隔离实验中只运行第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态；涉及写入或远程动作时严格遵守单目标授权。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed command in the isolated lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state; any write or remote action must stay within the one-target authorization.

attackChain.payload: $filter = New-WmiEventFilter -Name "evil" -Query "SELECT * FROM __InstanceModificationEvent WITHIN 60 WHERE TargetInstance ISA 'Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_System'"

title.zh: 关联 WMI 永久事件订阅审计 的控制面证据
title.en: Correlate Control-Plane Evidence for WMI Permanent Event-Subscription Audit

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 WMI 永久事件订阅审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the WMI Permanent Event-Subscription Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: WMI 永久事件订阅审计聚焦以下边界：只读取 root/subscription 中的过滤器、消费者和绑定并关联创建事件，不新建订阅。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: WMI Permanent Event-Subscription Audit focuses on this boundary: Reads filters, consumers, and bindings in root/subscription and correlates creation events without creating a subscription. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 持久化风险来自启动项、服务、WMI、账号、票据或模块加载位置允许未批准对象在登录、启动或认证时持续生效。验证应读取配置与事件并和批准基线比较，而不是为了证明风险而创建后门。
vulnerability.en: Persistence risk arises when startup items, services, WMI, accounts, tickets, or module-load locations allow unapproved objects to remain effective at logon, startup, or authentication. Validation should read configuration and events and compare them with an approved baseline rather than creating a backdoor to prove risk.

exploitation.zh: 使用 PAYLOADER_PERSISTENCE 只读查询收集对象名称、路径、签名、所有者、ACL、创建时间和审计事件，限制结果数量并与配置管理清单比较。不创建用户、服务、任务、注册表值、事件订阅或注入模块。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use PAYLOADER_PERSISTENCE read-only queries to collect object name, path, signature, owner, ACL, creation time, and audit event, limit result count, and compare with the configuration inventory. Do not create users, services, tasks, registry values, event subscriptions, or injected modules. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 移除未批准持久化对象，收紧启动位置、服务、WMI、计划任务、账号与目录 ACL，使用代码签名和应用控制，并为创建/修改事件建立告警。对域控实施分层管理、krbtgt 轮换与完整性监控，修复后重复只读基线。
mitigation.en: Remove unapproved persistence objects; tighten startup locations, services, WMI, scheduled tasks, accounts, and directory ACLs; enforce code signing and application control; and alert on create or modify events. Apply tiered administration, krbtgt rotation, and integrity monitoring to domain controllers and replay the read-only baseline.

description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 服务持久化配置审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the Service Persistence Configuration Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: 服务持久化配置审计聚焦以下边界：读取自动启动服务的路径、账户、签名和 ACL，不创建或启动服务。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Service Persistence Configuration Audit focuses on this boundary: Reads paths, accounts, signatures, and ACLs for auto-start services without creating or starting a service. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 持久化风险来自启动项、服务、WMI、账号、票据或模块加载位置允许未批准对象在登录、启动或认证时持续生效。验证应读取配置与事件并和批准基线比较，而不是为了证明风险而创建后门。
vulnerability.en: Persistence risk arises when startup items, services, WMI, accounts, tickets, or module-load locations allow unapproved objects to remain effective at logon, startup, or authentication. Validation should read configuration and events and compare them with an approved baseline rather than creating a backdoor to prove risk.

exploitation.zh: 使用 PAYLOADER_PERSISTENCE 只读查询收集对象名称、路径、签名、所有者、ACL、创建时间和审计事件，限制结果数量并与配置管理清单比较。不创建用户、服务、任务、注册表值、事件订阅或注入模块。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use PAYLOADER_PERSISTENCE read-only queries to collect object name, path, signature, owner, ACL, creation time, and audit event, limit result count, and compare with the configuration inventory. Do not create users, services, tasks, registry values, event subscriptions, or injected modules. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 移除未批准持久化对象，收紧启动位置、服务、WMI、计划任务、账号与目录 ACL，使用代码签名和应用控制，并为创建/修改事件建立告警。对域控实施分层管理、krbtgt 轮换与完整性监控，修复后重复只读基线。
mitigation.en: Remove unapproved persistence objects; tighten startup locations, services, WMI, scheduled tasks, accounts, and directory ACLs; enforce code signing and application control; and alert on create or modify events. Apply tiered administration, krbtgt rotation, and integrity monitoring to domain controllers and replay the read-only baseline.

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。

title.zh: 修复 异常本地账号持久化审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the Anomalous Local-Account Persistence Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: 异常本地账号持久化审计聚焦以下边界：只列出本地账号、管理员组和最近账号事件，与批准清单比较，不创建用户。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Anomalous Local-Account Persistence Audit focuses on this boundary: Lists local accounts, Administrators membership, and recent account events for comparison with an approved list without creating a user. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 持久化风险来自启动项、服务、WMI、账号、票据或模块加载位置允许未批准对象在登录、启动或认证时持续生效。验证应读取配置与事件并和批准基线比较，而不是为了证明风险而创建后门。
vulnerability.en: Persistence risk arises when startup items, services, WMI, accounts, tickets, or module-load locations allow unapproved objects to remain effective at logon, startup, or authentication. Validation should read configuration and events and compare them with an approved baseline rather than creating a backdoor to prove risk.

exploitation.zh: 使用 PAYLOADER_PERSISTENCE 只读查询收集对象名称、路径、签名、所有者、ACL、创建时间和审计事件，限制结果数量并与配置管理清单比较。不创建用户、服务、任务、注册表值、事件订阅或注入模块。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use PAYLOADER_PERSISTENCE read-only queries to collect object name, path, signature, owner, ACL, creation time, and audit event, limit result count, and compare with the configuration inventory. Do not create users, services, tasks, registry values, event subscriptions, or injected modules. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 移除未批准持久化对象，收紧启动位置、服务、WMI、计划任务、账号与目录 ACL，使用代码签名和应用控制，并为创建/修改事件建立告警。对域控实施分层管理、krbtgt 轮换与完整性监控，修复后重复只读基线。
mitigation.en: Remove unapproved persistence objects; tighten startup locations, services, WMI, scheduled tasks, accounts, and directory ACLs; enforce code signing and application control; and alert on create or modify events. Apply tiered administration, krbtgt rotation, and integrity monitoring to domain controllers and replay the read-only baseline.

exploitation.zh: 使用 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN 对单一实验对象执行有界只读查询，保存 DN、SID、权限 GUID、补丁、协议设置和事件 ID，并与权威目录/补丁基线核对。不写目录属性、改密码、注册域控、复制秘密、请求或注入票据。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use PAYLOADER_DOMAIN bounded read-only queries for one lab object, preserving DN, SID, permission GUID, patch, protocol setting, and event ID and comparing them with authoritative directory and patch baselines. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 实施分层管理和最小目录权限，收紧复制/委派/GPO/机器账号与信任配置，部署供应商补丁与强制模式，使用现代 Kerberos 加密、SMB/LDAP 签名和 EPA。监控敏感属性、复制、票据、机器重命名和域控注册事件。
mitigation.en: Apply tiered administration and least directory privilege; tighten replication, delegation, GPO, machine-account, and trust configuration; deploy vendor patches and enforcement modes; use modern Kerberos encryption, SMB and LDAP signing, and EPA; and monitor sensitive attributes, replication, tickets, machine renames, and controller registration.

description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: AMSI 完整性与事件审计聚焦以下边界：核对 AMSI 提供程序、PowerShell 事件和模块签名，不反射修改 AmsiUtils 或替换 amsi.dll。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: AMSI Integrity and Event Audit focuses on this boundary: Reviews AMSI providers, PowerShell events, and module signatures without reflectively changing Amsi Utils or replacing amsi.dll. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 终端风险来自脚本扫描、AMSI、ETW、模块签名、进程与命令行遥测之间存在盲区或完整性被破坏。验证目标是证明无害行为是否被稳定观测以及策略是否生效，不应通过关闭、patch 或规避安全控制来测试。
vulnerability.en: Endpoint risk arises from gaps or integrity failures across script scanning, AMSI, ETW, module signing, process, and command-line telemetry. Validation should prove whether harmless behavior is consistently observed and policy enforced, not test by disabling, patching, or evading security controls.

exploitation.zh: 运行一个本地签名或不可执行 PAYLOADER_EVASION 夹具，记录进程、脚本块、AMSI、ETW、模块加载与安全产品事件并对齐时间戳。只读取策略、签名、哈希和事件，不下载代码、修改内存、隐藏参数或执行 shellcode。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Run one local signed or non-executable PAYLOADER_EVASION fixture and align process, script-block, AMSI, ETW, module-load, and security-product events by timestamp. Read only policy, signatures, hashes, and events; do not download code, modify memory, hide arguments, or execute shellcode. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 启用并集中收集 PowerShell、AMSI、ETW、进程创建和模块加载遥测，实施应用控制、代码签名、受保护进程和防篡改，限制调试/注入权限并更新检测规则。对遥测中断、未签名模块、异常父子关系和内存映像建立告警。
mitigation.en: Enable and centralize PowerShell, AMSI, ETW, process-creation, and module-load telemetry; enforce application control, code signing, protected processes, and tamper protection; restrict debug and injection rights; update detections; and alert on telemetry gaps, unsigned modules, anomalous parent-child relationships, and memory images.

overview.zh: Excel DCOM 激活与 DDE 防护审计聚焦以下边界：核对 Excel COM 注册、远程激活权限和 DDE 策略，不启动远程 Excel 或子进程。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Excel DCOM Activation and DDE Protection Audit focuses on this boundary: Reviews Excel COM registration, remote-activation permissions, and DDE policy without starting remote Excel or a child process. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 横向风险来自远程管理协议、认证材料、服务控制、计划任务或会话权限超出分层管理边界。端口开放或管理协议可用只说明能力存在，只有未授权主体可执行远程动作并有目标端日志证明时才构成越权。
vulnerability.en: Lateral risk arises when remote-management protocols, authentication material, service control, scheduled tasks, or session permissions exceed the tiered administration boundary. An open port or available protocol shows capability only; unauthorized remote action plus target-side logs is required to prove an authorization failure.

exploitation.zh: 只对一台隔离实验主机运行 PAYLOADER_LATERAL 可达性、ACL 或事件查询，不传入真实口令、哈希、票据或远程命令。关联源主机、目标主机、防火墙和身份日志，确认协议、账号和授权范围；不创建服务、任务、进程或会话。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Run only a PAYLOADER_LATERAL reachability, ACL, or event query against one isolated lab host without real passwords, hashes, tickets, or remote commands. Correlate source, target, firewall, and identity logs to confirm protocol, account, and authorization scope; do not create services, tasks, processes, or sessions. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 限制远程管理到专用管理网与跳板机，实施主机防火墙、SMB/LDAP 签名、EPA、强认证和分层管理员账号，禁用不需要的 WMI/DCOM/RDP/WinRM。监控远程服务、任务、会话和异常 NTLM/Kerberos 使用。
mitigation.en: Restrict remote management to dedicated management networks and jump hosts; enforce host firewalls, SMB and LDAP signing, EPA, strong authentication, and tiered administrator accounts; disable unneeded WMI, DCOM, RDP, and WinRM; and monitor remote services, tasks, sessions, and anomalous NTLM or Kerberos use.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 确认 MMC DCOM 激活权限审计 的版本与授权边界
title.en: Confirm Version and Authorization for MMC DCOM Activation-Permission Audit

description.zh: 记录 MMC DCOM 激活权限审计 的实验对象、执行主体、系统或域版本、补丁、正常配置和停止条件，确认真实前置条件。
description.en: Record the lab object, execution principal, system or domain version, patches, normal configuration, and stop conditions for MMC DCOM Activation-Permission Audit and confirm the actual prerequisites.

title.zh: 运行一条 MMC DCOM 激活权限审计 已审查命令
title.en: Run One Reviewed MMC DCOM Activation-Permission Audit Command

description.zh: 在隔离实验中只运行第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态；涉及写入或远程动作时严格遵守单目标授权。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed command in the isolated lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state; any write or remote action must stay within the one-target authorization.

title.zh: 关联 MMC DCOM 激活权限审计 的控制面证据
title.en: Correlate Control-Plane Evidence for MMC DCOM Activation-Permission Audit

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 MMC DCOM 激活权限审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the MMC DCOM Activation-Permission Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: MMC DCOM 激活权限审计聚焦以下边界：核对 MMC20.Application 注册和远程激活权限，不调用 ExecuteShellCommand。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: MMC DCOM Activation-Permission Audit focuses on this boundary: Reviews MMC20.Application registration and remote-activation permission without calling Execute Shell Command. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 横向风险来自远程管理协议、认证材料、服务控制、计划任务或会话权限超出分层管理边界。端口开放或管理协议可用只说明能力存在，只有未授权主体可执行远程动作并有目标端日志证明时才构成越权。
vulnerability.en: Lateral risk arises when remote-management protocols, authentication material, service control, scheduled tasks, or session permissions exceed the tiered administration boundary. An open port or available protocol shows capability only; unauthorized remote action plus target-side logs is required to prove an authorization failure.

exploitation.zh: 只对一台隔离实验主机运行 PAYLOADER_LATERAL 可达性、ACL 或事件查询，不传入真实口令、哈希、票据或远程命令。关联源主机、目标主机、防火墙和身份日志，确认协议、账号和授权范围；不创建服务、任务、进程或会话。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Run only a PAYLOADER_LATERAL reachability, ACL, or event query against one isolated lab host without real passwords, hashes, tickets, or remote commands. Correlate source, target, firewall, and identity logs to confirm protocol, account, and authorization scope; do not create services, tasks, processes, or sessions. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 限制远程管理到专用管理网与跳板机，实施主机防火墙、SMB/LDAP 签名、EPA、强认证和分层管理员账号，禁用不需要的 WMI/DCOM/RDP/WinRM。监控远程服务、任务、会话和异常 NTLM/Kerberos 使用。
mitigation.en: Restrict remote management to dedicated management networks and jump hosts; enforce host firewalls, SMB and LDAP signing, EPA, strong authentication, and tiered administrator accounts; disable unneeded WMI, DCOM, RDP, and WinRM; and monitor remote services, tasks, sessions, and anomalous NTLM or Kerberos use.

description.en: RDP and NTLM Relay Classification Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

name.zh: 计划任务持久化安全核对

description.zh: 该条目保留为技术验证 Payload，保留原始可复现命令，仅补充授权实验、占位符边界、蓝队证据和回滚要求。
description.en: This entry remains a technical-validation payload with its reproducible commands preserved, adding only lab authorization, placeholder boundaries, blue-team evidence, and rollback requirements.

subCategory.zh: 计划任务持久化安全核对

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that assets, identities, domains, and directory scope belong to the authorized task, recording tool versions and query time.

prerequisites.en: Run retained commands one at a time only in a written, isolated, reversible lab authorization; record target, principal, and stop conditions for writes, authentication, remote actions, or credential handling.

title.zh: 计划任务持久化安全核对命令校正 4
title.en: Safe Scheduled-Task Persistence Review Command Repair 4

description.zh: 仅移除纯叙述或修正实验占位符，保留 计划任务持久化安全核对 的可复现技术语法；执行时记录授权、回滚和蓝队证据。
description.en: Remove narrative-only text or repair lab placeholders while preserving reproducible Safe Scheduled-Task Persistence Review syntax; record authorization, rollback, and blue-team evidence during execution.

analysis.zh: 报告应记录任务/条目、主体、触发时间、动作文件、权限差异和清理证据；命令帮助或现有任务名称不能单独证明持久化漏洞。
analysis.en: Reports should record the task or entry, principal, trigger time, action file, permission delta, and cleanup evidence; command help or an existing task name alone does not prove a persistence vulnerability.

opsecTips.zh: 限制查询次数和输出字段，不保存凭证、Token、邮件正文或无关用户属性。
opsecTips.en: Limit query count and output fields, and do not retain credentials, tokens, mail bodies, or unrelated user attributes.

opsecTips.zh: 检测到超出授权的写操作、认证尝试、非授权资产或异常请求量时立即停止、回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on writes, authentication attempts, unauthorized assets, or abnormal request volume outside the authorization.

title.zh: 建立计划任务持久化安全核对前置条件基线
title.en: Establish the Safe Scheduled-Task Persistence Review Prerequisite Baseline

description.zh: 记录 计划任务持久化安全核对 的当前主体、单一授权资产、组件或工具版本、适用条件、正常基线和停止条件；不把工具存在或查询成功直接判定为漏洞。
description.en: Record the principal, one authorized asset, component or tool version, applicability conditions, normal baseline, and stop conditions for Safe Scheduled-Task Persistence Review; do not treat tool availability or query success as a vulnerability.

title.zh: 运行一条计划任务持久化安全核对验证命令
title.en: Run One Safe Scheduled-Task Persistence Review Validation Command

description.zh: 只在授权实验中运行 计划任务持久化安全核对 的第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态，不串联其他动作。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed Safe Scheduled-Task Persistence Review command in the authorized lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state without chaining other actions.

title.zh: 关联计划任务持久化安全核对权威证据
title.en: Correlate Authoritative Safe Scheduled-Task Persistence Review Evidence

description.zh: 关联任务路径、触发器、运行身份、动作路径、文件 ACL、变更审批和系统日志，不执行动作或注册新任务。
description.en: Correlate task path, trigger, run identity, action path, file ACL, change approval, and system logs without executing an action or registering a new task.

title.zh: 修复并回归计划任务持久化安全核对
title.en: Remediate and Retest Safe Scheduled-Task Persistence Review

description.zh: 完成 计划任务持久化安全核对 对应的最小权限、补丁或配置修复后，以相同主体和同一条命令回归，确认正常管理能力保留且原证据链不再成立。
description.en: After the least-privilege, patch, or configuration remediation for Safe Scheduled-Task Persistence Review, retest with the same principal and command to confirm legitimate administration remains available and the original evidence chain no longer holds.

overview.zh: 计划任务持久化安全核对 保留为可独立复现的技术验证卡。原始命令能力不被删除；审校只处理明显叙述、占位符或不可执行片段，并要求隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据。
overview.en: Safe Scheduled-Task Persistence Review remains an independently reproducible technical-validation card. Original command capability is retained; review only repairs obvious narrative, placeholder, or non-executable fragments and requires isolated authorization, rollback, and blue-team evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 计划任务、Cron 条目和管理 cmdlet 是持久化管理面，不是漏洞本身。有效发现需要证明低权限主体可创建或修改高权限触发器，且该路径绕过审批或审计。
vulnerability.en: Scheduled tasks, Cron entries, and management cmdlets are persistence administration surfaces, not vulnerabilities by themselves. A valid finding requires proof that a low-privilege principal can create or modify a privileged trigger outside approved change and audit controls.

exploitation.zh: 先确认身份、范围、回滚点和蓝队采集，再按原始命令逐条执行；把能力结果与资产清单、目录配置、网络流量、端点遥测和服务端日志交叉核对。
exploitation.en: Confirm identity, scope, rollback point, and blue-team collection first, then run the retained commands one at a time; correlate capability results with inventory, directory configuration, network traffic, endpoint telemetry, and server logs.

mitigation.zh: 限制任务和 Cron 文件的写权限，按服务身份执行最小权限，启用创建/修改审计并清理遗留条目。修复后仅读取同一任务路径和审计事件，确认正常运维仍可用。
mitigation.en: Restrict write access to task and Cron definitions, run service identities with least privilege, audit creation and modification, and remove stale entries. Re-read the same task path and audit events after remediation while preserving legitimate operations.

name.zh: Skeleton Key 域控完整性审计

description.zh: Skeleton Key 域控完整性审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Skeleton Key Domain-Controller Integrity Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: Skeleton Key 域控完整性审计

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Skeleton Key 域控完整性审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Skeleton Key Domain-Controller Integrity Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.zh: Skeleton Key 域控完整性审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Skeleton Key 域控完整性审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.en: Record the lab object, execution principal, system or domain version, patches, normal configuration, and stop conditions for Skeleton Key Domain-Controller Integrity Audit and confirm the actual prerequisites.

description.en: Run only the first reviewed command in the isolated lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state; any write or remote action must stay within the one-target authorization.

title.zh: 关联 Skeleton Key 域控完整性审计 的控制面证据
title.en: Correlate Control-Plane Evidence for Skeleton Key Domain-Controller Integrity Audit

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 Skeleton Key 域控完整性审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the Skeleton Key Domain-Controller Integrity Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: Skeleton Key 域控完整性审计聚焦以下边界：核对域控制器 LSASS 模块、签名和认证异常，不注入补丁或测试万能密码。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Skeleton Key Domain-Controller Integrity Audit focuses on this boundary: Reviews domain-controller LSASS modules, signatures, and authentication anomalies without injecting a patch or testing a master password. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 持久化风险来自启动项、服务、WMI、账号、票据或模块加载位置允许未批准对象在登录、启动或认证时持续生效。验证应读取配置与事件并和批准基线比较，而不是为了证明风险而创建后门。
vulnerability.en: Persistence risk arises when startup items, services, WMI, accounts, tickets, or module-load locations allow unapproved objects to remain effective at logon, startup, or authentication. Validation should read configuration and events and compare them with an approved baseline rather than creating a backdoor to prove risk.

exploitation.zh: 使用 PAYLOADER_PERSISTENCE 只读查询收集对象名称、路径、签名、所有者、ACL、创建时间和审计事件，限制结果数量并与配置管理清单比较。不创建用户、服务、任务、注册表值、事件订阅或注入模块。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use PAYLOADER_PERSISTENCE read-only queries to collect object name, path, signature, owner, ACL, creation time, and audit event, limit result count, and compare with the configuration inventory. Do not create users, services, tasks, registry values, event subscriptions, or injected modules. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 移除未批准持久化对象，收紧启动位置、服务、WMI、计划任务、账号与目录 ACL，使用代码签名和应用控制，并为创建/修改事件建立告警。对域控实施分层管理、krbtgt 轮换与完整性监控，修复后重复只读基线。
mitigation.en: Remove unapproved persistence objects; tighten startup locations, services, WMI, scheduled tasks, accounts, and directory ACLs; enforce code signing and application control; and alert on create or modify events. Apply tiered administration, krbtgt rotation, and integrity monitoring to domain controllers and replay the read-only baseline.

description.en: Repair only narrative-only lines or obvious lab placeholders while preserving the SIDHistory Authorization-Baseline Audit capability; run it in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_PERSISTENCE_SID_HISTORY_E_3 with blue-team logs.

analysis.zh: SIDHistory 授权基线审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: SIDHistory 授权基线审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 确认 SIDHistory 授权基线审计 的版本与授权边界
title.en: Confirm Version and Authorization for SIDHistory Authorization-Baseline Audit

description.zh: 记录 SIDHistory 授权基线审计 的实验对象、执行主体、系统或域版本、补丁、正常配置和停止条件，确认真实前置条件。
description.en: Record the lab object, execution principal, system or domain version, patches, normal configuration, and stop conditions for SIDHistory Authorization-Baseline Audit and confirm the actual prerequisites.

title.zh: 运行一条 SIDHistory 授权基线审计 已审查命令
title.en: Run One Reviewed SIDHistory Authorization-Baseline Audit Command

description.zh: 在隔离实验中只运行第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态；涉及写入或远程动作时严格遵守单目标授权。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed command in the isolated lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state; any write or remote action must stay within the one-target authorization.

title.zh: 关联 SIDHistory 授权基线审计 的控制面证据
title.en: Correlate Control-Plane Evidence for SIDHistory Authorization-Baseline Audit

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 SIDHistory 授权基线审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the SIDHistory Authorization-Baseline Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: SIDHistory 授权基线审计聚焦以下边界：读取指定实验用户的 sIDHistory 并与批准迁移记录比较，不注入 SID 或登录。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: SID History Authorization-Baseline Audit focuses on this boundary: Reads s ID History for one lab user and compares it with approved migration records without injecting a SID or logging on. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 持久化风险来自启动项、服务、WMI、账号、票据或模块加载位置允许未批准对象在登录、启动或认证时持续生效。验证应读取配置与事件并和批准基线比较，而不是为了证明风险而创建后门。
vulnerability.en: Persistence risk arises when startup items, services, WMI, accounts, tickets, or module-load locations allow unapproved objects to remain effective at logon, startup, or authentication. Validation should read configuration and events and compare them with an approved baseline rather than creating a backdoor to prove risk.

exploitation.zh: 使用 PAYLOADER_PERSISTENCE 只读查询收集对象名称、路径、签名、所有者、ACL、创建时间和审计事件，限制结果数量并与配置管理清单比较。不创建用户、服务、任务、注册表值、事件订阅或注入模块。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use PAYLOADER_PERSISTENCE read-only queries to collect object name, path, signature, owner, ACL, creation time, and audit event, limit result count, and compare with the configuration inventory. Do not create users, services, tasks, registry values, event subscriptions, or injected modules. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 移除未批准持久化对象，收紧启动位置、服务、WMI、计划任务、账号与目录 ACL，使用代码签名和应用控制，并为创建/修改事件建立告警。对域控实施分层管理、krbtgt 轮换与完整性监控，修复后重复只读基线。
mitigation.en: Remove unapproved persistence objects; tighten startup locations, services, WMI, scheduled tasks, accounts, and directory ACLs; enforce code signing and application control; and alert on create or modify events. Apply tiered administration, krbtgt rotation, and integrity monitoring to domain controllers and replay the read-only baseline.

name.zh: 进程镂空遥测与内存审计

description.zh: 进程镂空遥测与内存审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Process-Hollowing Telemetry and Memory Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: 进程镂空遥测与内存审计

prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Process-Hollowing Telemetry and Memory Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

analysis.en: Zerologon 补丁与协议配置审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

description.zh: 记录 Zerologon 补丁与协议配置审计 的实验对象、执行主体、系统或域版本、补丁、正常配置和停止条件，确认真实前置条件。
description.en: Record the lab object, execution principal, system or domain version, patches, normal configuration, and stop conditions for Zerologon Patch and Protocol Configuration Audit and confirm the actual prerequisites.

title.zh: 运行一条 Zerologon 补丁与协议配置审计 已审查命令
title.en: Run One Reviewed Zerologon Patch and Protocol Configuration Audit Command

description.zh: 在隔离实验中只运行第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态；涉及写入或远程动作时严格遵守单目标授权。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed command in the isolated lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state; any write or remote action must stay within the one-target authorization.

title.zh: 关联 Zerologon 补丁与协议配置审计 的控制面证据
title.en: Correlate Control-Plane Evidence for Zerologon Patch and Protocol Configuration Audit

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 Zerologon 补丁与协议配置审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the Zerologon Patch and Protocol Configuration Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: Zerologon 补丁与协议配置审计聚焦以下边界：只核对实验域控制器版本、补丁、安全通道事件和强制模式，不重置机器账号密码。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Zerologon Patch and Protocol Configuration Audit focuses on this boundary: Reviews lab domain-controller version, patches, secure-channel events, and enforcement mode without resetting a machine-account password. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 域风险来自复制、委派、信任、票据、组策略、机器账号或协议补丁边界过宽。有效结论必须绑定精确域、对象、权限、补丁和事件，不能把可读取目录、工具输出或旧 CVE 名称直接拼成通用域管链。
vulnerability.en: Domain risk arises when replication, delegation, trust, ticket, Group Policy, machine-account, or protocol patch boundaries are overly broad. A valid result binds the exact domain, object, permission, patch, and event and does not combine readable directory data, tool output, or old CVE names into a universal domain-admin chain.

exploitation.zh: 使用 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN 对单一实验对象执行有界只读查询，保存 DN、SID、权限 GUID、补丁、协议设置和事件 ID，并与权威目录/补丁基线核对。不写目录属性、改密码、注册域控、复制秘密、请求或注入票据。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use PAYLOADER_DOMAIN bounded read-only queries for one lab object, preserving DN, SID, permission GUID, patch, protocol setting, and event ID and comparing them with authoritative directory and patch baselines. Do not write directory attributes, change passwords, register controllers, replicate secrets, or request or inject tickets. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 实施分层管理和最小目录权限，收紧复制/委派/GPO/机器账号与信任配置，部署供应商补丁与强制模式，使用现代 Kerberos 加密、SMB/LDAP 签名和 EPA。监控敏感属性、复制、票据、机器重命名和域控注册事件。
mitigation.en: Apply tiered administration and least directory privilege; tighten replication, delegation, GPO, machine-account, and trust configuration; deploy vendor patches and enforcement modes; use modern Kerberos encryption, SMB and LDAP signing, and EPA; and monitor sensitive attributes, replication, tickets, machine renames, and controller registration.

title.zh: 关联 PetitPotam/EFSRPC 暴露审计 的控制面证据

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 PetitPotam/EFSRPC 暴露审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the Petit Potam and EFSRPC Exposure Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: PetitPotam/EFSRPC 暴露审计聚焦以下边界：核对 EFSRPC 可达性、NTLM 限制、AD CS EPA 和相关事件，不强制域控认证或中继。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Petit Potam and EFSRPC Exposure Audit focuses on this boundary: Reviews EFSRPC reachability, NTLM restrictions, AD CS EPA, and related events without coercing domain-controller authentication or relaying it. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 域风险来自复制、委派、信任、票据、组策略、机器账号或协议补丁边界过宽。有效结论必须绑定精确域、对象、权限、补丁和事件，不能把可读取目录、工具输出或旧 CVE 名称直接拼成通用域管链。
vulnerability.en: Domain risk arises when replication, delegation, trust, ticket, Group Policy, machine-account, or protocol patch boundaries are overly broad. A valid result binds the exact domain, object, permission, patch, and event and does not combine readable directory data, tool output, or old CVE names into a universal domain-admin chain.

exploitation.zh: 使用 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN 对单一实验对象执行有界只读查询，保存 DN、SID、权限 GUID、补丁、协议设置和事件 ID，并与权威目录/补丁基线核对。不写目录属性、改密码、注册域控、复制秘密、请求或注入票据。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use PAYLOADER_DOMAIN bounded read-only queries for one lab object, preserving DN, SID, permission GUID, patch, protocol setting, and event ID and comparing them with authoritative directory and patch baselines. Do not write directory attributes, change passwords, register controllers, replicate secrets, or request or inject tickets. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 实施分层管理和最小目录权限，收紧复制/委派/GPO/机器账号与信任配置，部署供应商补丁与强制模式，使用现代 Kerberos 加密、SMB/LDAP 签名和 EPA。监控敏感属性、复制、票据、机器重命名和域控注册事件。
mitigation.en: Apply tiered administration and least directory privilege; tighten replication, delegation, GPO, machine-account, and trust configuration; deploy vendor patches and enforcement modes; use modern Kerberos encryption, SMB and LDAP signing, and EPA; and monitor sensitive attributes, replication, tickets, machine renames, and controller registration.

vulnerability.zh: 域风险来自复制、委派、信任、票据、组策略、机器账号或协议补丁边界过宽。有效结论必须绑定精确域、对象、权限、补丁和事件，不能把可读取目录、工具输出或旧 CVE 名称直接拼成通用域管链。
vulnerability.en: Domain risk arises when replication, delegation, trust, ticket, Group Policy, machine-account, or protocol patch boundaries are overly broad. A valid result binds the exact domain, object, permission, patch, and event and does not combine readable directory data, tool output, or old CVE names into a universal domain-admin chain.

exploitation.zh: 使用 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN 对单一实验对象执行有界只读查询，保存 DN、SID、权限 GUID、补丁、协议设置和事件 ID，并与权威目录/补丁基线核对。不写目录属性、改密码、注册域控、复制秘密、请求或注入票据。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use PAYLOADER_DOMAIN bounded read-only queries for one lab object, preserving DN, SID, permission GUID, patch, protocol setting, and event ID and comparing them with authoritative directory and patch baselines. Do not write directory attributes, change passwords, register controllers, replicate secrets, or request or inject tickets. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 实施分层管理和最小目录权限，收紧复制/委派/GPO/机器账号与信任配置，部署供应商补丁与强制模式，使用现代 Kerberos 加密、SMB/LDAP 签名和 EPA。监控敏感属性、复制、票据、机器重命名和域控注册事件。
mitigation.en: Apply tiered administration and least directory privilege; tighten replication, delegation, GPO, machine-account, and trust configuration; deploy vendor patches and enforcement modes; use modern Kerberos encryption, SMB and LDAP signing, and EPA; and monitor sensitive attributes, replication, tickets, machine renames, and controller registration.

Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: ETW 提供程序完整性审计

prerequisites.zh: 确认 ETW 提供程序完整性审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for ETW Provider Integrity Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

title.zh: ETW 提供程序完整性审计校正命令 1
title.en: ETW Provider Integrity Audit Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 仅修正原命令中的纯叙述行或明显实验占位符，保留 ETW 提供程序完整性审计 技术能力；在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_ETW_PATCH_E_1 与蓝队日志。
description.en: Repair only narrative-only lines or obvious lab placeholders while preserving the ETW Provider Integrity Audit capability; run it in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_ETW_PATCH_E_1 with blue-team logs.

title.zh: C#禁用ETW
title.en: C#Disable ETW

execution.command:
Assembly.Load("System.Diagnostics.Tracing")
Type etwType = typeof(EventProvider)
MethodInfo setEnabled = etwType.GetMethod("SetEnabled", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static)
setEnabled.Invoke(null, new object[] { Guid.NewGuid(), 0, 0 })

description.zh: C#禁用ETW
description.en: C#Disable ETW

title.zh: 修补ntdll
title.en: Patch ntdll

description.zh: 修补EtwEventWrite
description.en: Patch Etw Event Write

analysis.zh: ETW 提供程序完整性审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: ETW 提供程序完整性审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 确认 ETW 提供程序完整性审计 的版本与授权边界
title.en: Confirm Version and Authorization for ETW Provider Integrity Audit

description.zh: 记录 ETW 提供程序完整性审计 的实验对象、执行主体、系统或域版本、补丁、正常配置和停止条件，确认真实前置条件。
description.en: Record the lab object, execution principal, system or domain version, patches, normal configuration, and stop conditions for ETW Provider Integrity Audit and confirm the actual prerequisites.

title.zh: 运行一条 ETW 提供程序完整性审计 已审查命令
title.en: Run One Reviewed ETW Provider Integrity Audit Command

description.zh: 在隔离实验中只运行第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态；涉及写入或远程动作时严格遵守单目标授权。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed command in the isolated lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state; any write or remote action must stay within the one-target authorization.

title.zh: 关联 ETW 提供程序完整性审计 的控制面证据
title.en: Correlate Control-Plane Evidence for ETW Provider Integrity Audit

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 ETW 提供程序完整性审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the ETW Provider Integrity Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: ETW 提供程序完整性审计聚焦以下边界：核对 ETW 提供程序注册、事件连续性和内存保护，不 patch EtwEventWrite。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: ETW Provider Integrity Audit focuses on this boundary: Reviews ETW provider registration, event continuity, and memory protections without patching Etw Event Write. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 终端风险来自脚本扫描、AMSI、ETW、模块签名、进程与命令行遥测之间存在盲区或完整性被破坏。验证目标是证明无害行为是否被稳定观测以及策略是否生效，不应通过关闭、patch 或规避安全控制来测试。
vulnerability.en: Endpoint risk arises from gaps or integrity failures across script scanning, AMSI, ETW, module signing, process, and command-line telemetry. Validation should prove whether harmless behavior is consistently observed and policy enforced, not test by disabling, patching, or evading security controls.

exploitation.zh: 运行一个本地签名或不可执行 PAYLOADER_EVASION 夹具，记录进程、脚本块、AMSI、ETW、模块加载与安全产品事件并对齐时间戳。只读取策略、签名、哈希和事件，不下载代码、修改内存、隐藏参数或执行 shellcode。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Run one local signed or non-executable PAYLOADER_EVASION fixture and align process, script-block, AMSI, ETW, module-load, and security-product events by timestamp. Read only policy, signatures, hashes, and events; do not download code, modify memory, hide arguments, or execute shellcode. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 启用并集中收集 PowerShell、AMSI、ETW、进程创建和模块加载遥测，实施应用控制、代码签名、受保护进程和防篡改，限制调试/注入权限并更新检测规则。对遥测中断、未签名模块、异常父子关系和内存映像建立告警。
mitigation.en: Enable and centralize PowerShell, AMSI, ETW, process-creation, and module-load telemetry; enforce application control, code signing, protected processes, and tamper protection; restrict debug and injection rights; update detections; and alert on telemetry gaps, unsigned modules, anomalous parent-child relationships, and memory images.

name.zh: 进程注入能力安全预检

description.zh: 该条目保留为技术验证 Payload，保留原始可复现命令，仅补充授权实验、占位符边界、蓝队证据和回滚要求。
description.en: This entry remains a technical-validation payload with its reproducible commands preserved, adding only lab authorization, placeholder boundaries, blue-team evidence, and rollback requirements.

subCategory.zh: 进程注入能力安全预检

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that assets, identities, domains, and directory scope belong to the authorized task, recording tool versions and query time.

prerequisites.zh: 保留命令只可在书面授权、隔离、可回滚的实验中逐条执行；写入、认证、远程动作和凭据处理必须记录目标、主体与停止条件。
prerequisites.en: Run retained commands one at a time only in a written, isolated, reversible lab authorization; record target, principal, and stop conditions for writes, authentication, remote actions, or credential handling.

title.zh: 经典DLL注入
title.en: Classic DLL Injection

description.zh: DLL注入
description.en: DLL Injection

title.zh: Process Hollowing
title.en: Process Hollowing

title.en: APCInjection

analysis.zh: 结论必须说明发布者、路径、策略规则、主体令牌和执行/写入证据；二进制存在或帮助输出不能单独证明绕过。
analysis.en: Conclusions must state publisher, path, policy rule, principal token, and execution or write evidence; binary presence or help output alone does not prove a bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 限制查询次数和输出字段，不保存凭证、Token、邮件正文或无关用户属性。
opsecTips.en: Limit query count and output fields, and do not retain credentials, tokens, mail bodies, or unrelated user attributes.

opsecTips.zh: 检测到超出授权的写操作、认证尝试、非授权资产或异常请求量时立即停止、回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on writes, authentication attempts, unauthorized assets, or abnormal request volume outside the authorization.

title.zh: 建立进程注入能力安全预检前置条件基线
title.en: Establish the Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight Prerequisite Baseline

description.zh: 记录 进程注入能力安全预检 的当前主体、单一授权资产、组件或工具版本、适用条件、正常基线和停止条件；不把工具存在或查询成功直接判定为漏洞。
description.en: Record the principal, one authorized asset, component or tool version, applicability conditions, normal baseline, and stop conditions for Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight; do not treat tool availability or query success as a vulnerability.

title.zh: 运行一条进程注入能力安全预检验证命令
title.en: Run One Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight Validation Command

description.zh: 只在授权实验中运行 进程注入能力安全预检 的第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态，不串联其他动作。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight command in the authorized lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state without chaining other actions.

title.zh: 关联进程注入能力安全预检权威证据
title.en: Correlate Authoritative Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight Evidence

description.zh: 保存签名状态、策略命中、进程路径、父子关系、令牌和审计事件，区分合法系统组件调用与未授权代码执行。
description.en: Preserve signature status, policy decisions, process paths, parent-child relationships, tokens, and audit events to distinguish legitimate system-component use from unauthorized code execution.

title.zh: 修复并回归进程注入能力安全预检
title.en: Remediate and Retest Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight

description.zh: 完成 进程注入能力安全预检 对应的最小权限、补丁或配置修复后，以相同主体和同一条命令回归，确认正常管理能力保留且原证据链不再成立。
description.en: After the least-privilege, patch, or configuration remediation for Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight, retest with the same principal and command to confirm legitimate administration remains available and the original evidence chain no longer holds.

overview.zh: 进程注入能力安全预检 保留为可独立复现的技术验证卡。原始命令能力不被删除；审校只处理明显叙述、占位符或不可执行片段，并要求隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据。
overview.en: Safe Process-Injection Capability Preflight remains an independently reproducible technical-validation card. Original command capability is retained; review only repairs obvious narrative, placeholder, or non-executable fragments and requires isolated authorization, rollback, and blue-team evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 签名二进制、AppLocker 规则和进程注入 API 的存在或签名状态不是漏洞。有效发现需要证明策略允许未授权代码执行、跨边界进程写入或绕过审计，并由策略、令牌、进程树和日志证实。
vulnerability.en: The presence or signature state of signed binaries, App Locker rules, and process-injection AP Is is not a vulnerability by itself. A valid finding requires proof that policy permits unauthorized code execution, cross-boundary process writes, or audit bypass, corroborated by policy, tokens, process trees, and logs.

exploitation.zh: 先确认身份、范围、回滚点和蓝队采集，再按原始命令逐条执行；把能力结果与资产清单、目录配置、网络流量、端点遥测和服务端日志交叉核对。
exploitation.en: Confirm identity, scope, rollback point, and blue-team collection first, then run the retained commands one at a time; correlate capability results with inventory, directory configuration, network traffic, endpoint telemetry, and server logs.

mitigation.zh: 按路径和发布者收紧 AppLocker/WDAC 规则，阻止用户可写目录中的代理执行，启用进程访问审计与 终端安全监控 规则并限制调试权限。修复后只做签名和策略预检。
mitigation.en: Tighten App Locker or WDAC rules by path and publisher, block proxy execution from user-writable directories, enable process-access auditing and endpoint monitoring rules, and restrict debug privileges. Re-run signature and policy preflights after remediation.

description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归聚焦以下边界：核对 Exchange 精确版本、补丁、前端/后端路由与无会话响应，不运行利用脚本。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression focuses on this boundary: Reviews exact Exchange version, patches, front-end and backend routing, and no-session responses without running an exploit script. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: Exchange 风险必须绑定精确产品版本、累积更新、安全更新、启用角色和前后端路由。公开端点、HTTP 状态或产品名称不能证明 ProxyLogon、ProxyShell 或 ProxyToken；必须有补丁前置条件和服务端授权差异。
vulnerability.en: Exchange 风险必须绑定精确产品版本、累积更新、安全更新、启用角色和前后端路由。公开端点、HTTP 状态或产品名称不能证明 ProxyLogon、ProxyShell 或 ProxyToken；必须有补丁前置条件和服务端授权差异。

exploitation.zh: 在隔离 Exchange 实验环境运行 PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE 版本、补丁、端点和无会话响应查询，保存 AdminDisplayVersion、更新清单、IIS/Exchange 日志与请求 ID。不访问邮箱、导出 PST、伪造头、写 WebShell 或执行利用脚本。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Run PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE version, patch, endpoint, and no-session response queries in an isolated Exchange lab, preserving Admin Display Version, update inventory, IIS and Exchange logs, and request I Ds. Do not access mailboxes, export PST, forge headers, write web shells, or run exploit scripts. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 升级到受支持的 Exchange CU 并安装最新安全更新，运行供应商健康检查，限制管理端点与 ECP/PowerShell 暴露，强化 EPA、身份与反向代理规则。对异常 Autodiscover、EWS、MAPI、PowerShell 和邮箱权限变更建立审计。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to a supported Exchange CU and current security update, run vendor health checks, restrict management endpoints and ECP or PowerShell exposure, and strengthen EPA, identity, and reverse-proxy rules. Audit anomalous Autodiscover, EWS, MAPI, PowerShell, and mailbox-permission changes.

title.zh: 修复 SAM The Admin/noPac 重复语义审计 边界并回归

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: SAM The Admin/noPac 重复语义审计聚焦以下边界：将该别名与 sAMAccountName/PAC 边界统一，核对补丁和事件，不获取 shell 或执行远程命令。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: SAM The Admin/no Pac 重复语义审计聚焦以下边界：将该别名与 s AM Account Name/PAC 边界统一，核对补丁和事件，不获取 shell 或执行远程命令。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。

vulnerability.zh: 域风险来自复制、委派、信任、票据、组策略、机器账号或协议补丁边界过宽。有效结论必须绑定精确域、对象、权限、补丁和事件，不能把可读取目录、工具输出或旧 CVE 名称直接拼成通用域管链。
vulnerability.en: Domain risk arises when replication, delegation, trust, ticket, Group Policy, machine-account, or protocol patch boundaries are overly broad. A valid result binds the exact domain, object, permission, patch, and event and does not combine readable directory data, tool output, or old CVE names into a universal domain-admin chain.

exploitation.zh: 使用 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN 对单一实验对象执行有界只读查询，保存 DN、SID、权限 GUID、补丁、协议设置和事件 ID，并与权威目录/补丁基线核对。不写目录属性、改密码、注册域控、复制秘密、请求或注入票据。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Use PAYLOADER_DOMAIN bounded read-only queries for one lab object, preserving DN, SID, permission GUID, patch, protocol setting, and event ID and comparing them with authoritative directory and patch baselines. Do not write directory attributes, change passwords, register controllers, replicate secrets, or request or inject tickets. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 实施分层管理和最小目录权限，收紧复制/委派/GPO/机器账号与信任配置，部署供应商补丁与强制模式，使用现代 Kerberos 加密、SMB/LDAP 签名和 EPA。监控敏感属性、复制、票据、机器重命名和域控注册事件。
mitigation.en: Apply tiered administration and least directory privilege; tighten replication, delegation, GPO, machine-account, and trust configuration; deploy vendor patches and enforcement modes; use modern Kerberos encryption, SMB and LDAP signing, and EPA; and monitor sensitive attributes, replication, tickets, machine renames, and controller registration.

description.zh: 在隔离实验中只运行第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态；涉及写入或远程动作时严格遵守单目标授权。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed command in the isolated lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state; any write or remote action must stay within the one-target authorization.

title.zh: 关联 进程模块签名策略审计 的控制面证据
title.en: Correlate Control-Plane Evidence for Process Module-Signature Policy Audit

description.zh: 把唯一标记与身份、目录、系统、网络或安全产品事件对齐，并排除管理员正常能力、工具输出、缓存和版本不匹配。
description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.zh: 修复 进程模块签名策略审计 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate the Process Module-Signature Policy Audit Boundary and Regress

description.zh: 应用最小权限、补丁或配置修复后重复正常与只读标记查询，确认管理功能保留且非预期权限、可见性或遥测缺口消失。
description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: 进程模块签名策略审计聚焦以下边界：读取目标进程的 BinarySignaturePolicy 与模块加载事件，不创建受保护进程或屏蔽安全 DLL。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Process Module-Signature Policy Audit focuses on this boundary: Reads Binary Signature Policy and module-load events for a target process without creating a protected process or blocking security DL Ls. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 终端风险来自脚本扫描、AMSI、ETW、模块签名、进程与命令行遥测之间存在盲区或完整性被破坏。验证目标是证明无害行为是否被稳定观测以及策略是否生效，不应通过关闭、patch 或规避安全控制来测试。
vulnerability.en: Endpoint risk arises from gaps or integrity failures across script scanning, AMSI, ETW, module signing, process, and command-line telemetry. Validation should prove whether harmless behavior is consistently observed and policy enforced, not test by disabling, patching, or evading security controls.

exploitation.zh: 运行一个本地签名或不可执行 PAYLOADER_EVASION 夹具，记录进程、脚本块、AMSI、ETW、模块加载与安全产品事件并对齐时间戳。只读取策略、签名、哈希和事件，不下载代码、修改内存、隐藏参数或执行 shellcode。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Run one local signed or non-executable PAYLOADER_EVASION fixture and align process, script-block, AMSI, ETW, module-load, and security-product events by timestamp. Read only policy, signatures, hashes, and events; do not download code, modify memory, hide arguments, or execute shellcode. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 启用并集中收集 PowerShell、AMSI、ETW、进程创建和模块加载遥测，实施应用控制、代码签名、受保护进程和防篡改，限制调试/注入权限并更新检测规则。对遥测中断、未签名模块、异常父子关系和内存映像建立告警。
mitigation.en: Enable and centralize PowerShell, AMSI, ETW, process-creation, and module-load telemetry; enforce application control, code signing, protected processes, and tamper protection; restrict debug and injection rights; update detections; and alert on telemetry gaps, unsigned modules, anomalous parent-child relationships, and memory images.

Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: 进程映像与命令行一致性审计聚焦以下边界：关联进程映像路径、签名、父进程和命令行遥测，不创建挂起或伪装进程。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Process Image and Command-Line Consistency Audit focuses on this boundary: Correlates process image path, signature, parent, and command-line telemetry without creating a suspended or masqueraded process. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 终端风险来自脚本扫描、AMSI、ETW、模块签名、进程与命令行遥测之间存在盲区或完整性被破坏。验证目标是证明无害行为是否被稳定观测以及策略是否生效，不应通过关闭、patch 或规避安全控制来测试。
vulnerability.en: Endpoint risk arises from gaps or integrity failures across script scanning, AMSI, ETW, module signing, process, and command-line telemetry. Validation should prove whether harmless behavior is consistently observed and policy enforced, not test by disabling, patching, or evading security controls.

exploitation.zh: 运行一个本地签名或不可执行 PAYLOADER_EVASION 夹具，记录进程、脚本块、AMSI、ETW、模块加载与安全产品事件并对齐时间戳。只读取策略、签名、哈希和事件，不下载代码、修改内存、隐藏参数或执行 shellcode。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Run one local signed or non-executable PAYLOADER_EVASION fixture and align process, script-block, AMSI, ETW, module-load, and security-product events by timestamp. Read only policy, signatures, hashes, and events; do not download code, modify memory, hide arguments, or execute shellcode. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 启用并集中收集 PowerShell、AMSI、ETW、进程创建和模块加载遥测，实施应用控制、代码签名、受保护进程和防篡改，限制调试/注入权限并更新检测规则。对遥测中断、未签名模块、异常父子关系和内存映像建立告警。
mitigation.en: Enable and centralize PowerShell, AMSI, ETW, process-creation, and module-load telemetry; enforce application control, code signing, protected processes, and tamper protection; restrict debug and injection rights; update detections; and alert on telemetry gaps, unsigned modules, anomalous parent-child relationships, and memory images.

name.zh: 父进程属性与遥测一致性审计

description.zh: 父进程属性与遥测一致性审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Parent-Process Attribute and Telemetry Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 父进程属性与遥测一致性审计

prerequisites.zh: 确认 父进程属性与遥测一致性审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Parent-Process Attribute and Telemetry Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

mitigation.en: Enable and centralize PowerShell, AMSI, ETW, process-creation, and module-load telemetry; enforce application control, code signing, protected processes, and tamper protection; restrict debug and injection rights; update detections; and alert on telemetry gaps, unsigned modules, anomalous parent-child relationships, and memory images.

opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.en: Align the unique marker with identity, directory, system, network, or security-product events and exclude normal administrator capability, tool output, caching, and version mismatch.

title.en: Remediate the Process-Argument Multi-Source Telemetry Audit Boundary and Regress
