description.en: Apply least privilege, a patch, or configuration remediation and repeat the normal and read-only marker queries to preserve administration while removing unintended privilege, visibility, or telemetry gaps.

overview.zh: 进程参数多源遥测审计聚焦以下边界：比较创建事件、PEB 快照和安全产品命令行字段，不修改 PEB 或隐藏参数。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Process-Argument Multi-Source Telemetry Audit focuses on this boundary: Compares process-creation events, PEB snapshots, and security-product command-line fields without modifying the PEB or hiding arguments. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 终端风险来自脚本扫描、AMSI、ETW、模块签名、进程与命令行遥测之间存在盲区或完整性被破坏。验证目标是证明无害行为是否被稳定观测以及策略是否生效，不应通过关闭、patch 或规避安全控制来测试。
vulnerability.en: Endpoint risk arises from gaps or integrity failures across script scanning, AMSI, ETW, module signing, process, and command-line telemetry. Validation should prove whether harmless behavior is consistently observed and policy enforced, not test by disabling, patching, or evading security controls.

exploitation.zh: 运行一个本地签名或不可执行 PAYLOADER_EVASION 夹具，记录进程、脚本块、AMSI、ETW、模块加载与安全产品事件并对齐时间戳。只读取策略、签名、哈希和事件，不下载代码、修改内存、隐藏参数或执行 shellcode。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Run one local signed or non-executable PAYLOADER_EVASION fixture and align process, script-block, AMSI, ETW, module-load, and security-product events by timestamp. Read only policy, signatures, hashes, and events; do not download code, modify memory, hide arguments, or execute shellcode. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 启用并集中收集 PowerShell、AMSI、ETW、进程创建和模块加载遥测，实施应用控制、代码签名、受保护进程和防篡改，限制调试/注入权限并更新检测规则。对遥测中断、未签名模块、异常父子关系和内存映像建立告警。
mitigation.en: Enable and centralize PowerShell, AMSI, ETW, process-creation, and module-load telemetry; enforce application control, code signing, protected processes, and tamper protection; restrict debug and injection rights; update detections; and alert on telemetry gaps, unsigned modules, anomalous parent-child relationships, and memory images.

description.en: This entry remains a technical-validation payload with its reproducible commands preserved, adding only lab authorization, placeholder boundaries, blue-team evidence, and rollback requirements.

prerequisites.zh: 确认资产、账号、域名或目录范围属于当前授权任务，并记录工具版本与查询时间。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that assets, identities, domains, and directory scope belong to the authorized task, recording tool versions and query time.

prerequisites.en: Run retained commands one at a time only in a written, isolated, reversible lab authorization; record target, principal, and stop conditions for writes, authentication, remote actions, or credential handling.

opsecTips.en: Limit query count and output fields, and do not retain credentials, tokens, mail bodies, or unrelated user attributes.

opsecTips.en: Stop, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on writes, authentication attempts, unauthorized assets, or abnormal request volume outside the authorization.

description.zh: 保存签名状态、策略命中、进程路径、父子关系、令牌和审计事件，区分合法系统组件调用与未授权代码执行。
description.en: Preserve signature status, policy decisions, process paths, parent-child relationships, tokens, and audit events to distinguish legitimate system-component use from unauthorized code execution.

description.en: After the least-privilege, patch, or configuration remediation for Safe Signed-Binary Policy Preflight, retest with the same principal and command to confirm legitimate administration remains available and the original evidence chain no longer holds.

overview.zh: 签名二进制策略安全预检 保留为可独立复现的技术验证卡。原始命令能力不被删除；审校只处理明显叙述、占位符或不可执行片段，并要求隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据。
overview.en: Safe Signed-Binary Policy Preflight remains an independently reproducible technical-validation card. Original command capability is retained; review only repairs obvious narrative, placeholder, or non-executable fragments and requires isolated authorization, rollback, and blue-team evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 签名二进制、AppLocker 规则和进程注入 API 的存在或签名状态不是漏洞。有效发现需要证明策略允许未授权代码执行、跨边界进程写入或绕过审计，并由策略、令牌、进程树和日志证实。
vulnerability.en: The presence or signature state of signed binaries, App Locker rules, and process-injection AP Is is not a vulnerability by itself. A valid finding requires proof that policy permits unauthorized code execution, cross-boundary process writes, or audit bypass, corroborated by policy, tokens, process trees, and logs.

exploitation.zh: 先确认身份、范围、回滚点和蓝队采集，再按原始命令逐条执行；把能力结果与资产清单、目录配置、网络流量、端点遥测和服务端日志交叉核对。
exploitation.en: Confirm identity, scope, rollback point, and blue-team collection first, then run the retained commands one at a time; correlate capability results with inventory, directory configuration, network traffic, endpoint telemetry, and server logs.

mitigation.zh: 按路径和发布者收紧 AppLocker/WDAC 规则，阻止用户可写目录中的代理执行，启用进程访问审计与 终端安全监控 规则并限制调试权限。修复后只做签名和策略预检。
mitigation.en: Tighten App Locker or WDAC rules by path and publisher, block proxy execution from user-writable directories, enable process-access auditing and endpoint monitoring rules, and restrict debug privileges. Re-run signature and policy preflights after remediation.

overview.zh: CLR 程序集加载遥测审计聚焦以下边界：使用签名无害程序集核对 CLR Runtime、程序集加载和进程事件，不在其他进程内加载代码。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: CLR Assembly-Load Telemetry Audit focuses on this boundary: Uses a signed harmless assembly to review CLR runtime, assembly-load, and process events without loading code into another process. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: 终端风险来自脚本扫描、AMSI、ETW、模块签名、进程与命令行遥测之间存在盲区或完整性被破坏。验证目标是证明无害行为是否被稳定观测以及策略是否生效，不应通过关闭、patch 或规避安全控制来测试。
vulnerability.en: Endpoint risk arises from gaps or integrity failures across script scanning, AMSI, ETW, module signing, process, and command-line telemetry. Validation should prove whether harmless behavior is consistently observed and policy enforced, not test by disabling, patching, or evading security controls.

exploitation.zh: 运行一个本地签名或不可执行 PAYLOADER_EVASION 夹具，记录进程、脚本块、AMSI、ETW、模块加载与安全产品事件并对齐时间戳。只读取策略、签名、哈希和事件，不下载代码、修改内存、隐藏参数或执行 shellcode。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Run one local signed or non-executable PAYLOADER_EVASION fixture and align process, script-block, AMSI, ETW, module-load, and security-product events by timestamp. Read only policy, signatures, hashes, and events; do not download code, modify memory, hide arguments, or execute shellcode. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 启用并集中收集 PowerShell、AMSI、ETW、进程创建和模块加载遥测，实施应用控制、代码签名、受保护进程和防篡改，限制调试/注入权限并更新检测规则。对遥测中断、未签名模块、异常父子关系和内存映像建立告警。
mitigation.en: Enable and centralize PowerShell, AMSI, ETW, process-creation, and module-load telemetry; enforce application control, code signing, protected processes, and tamper protection; restrict debug and injection rights; update detections; and alert on telemetry gaps, unsigned modules, anomalous parent-child relationships, and memory images.

overview.zh: Exchange ProxyToken 授权回归聚焦以下边界：核对精确版本、补丁和前后端授权响应，不伪造 X-ClientApplication 或授予邮箱权限。 审校后保留原始技术能力，并按实验授权、执行前提、蓝队证据和修复回归组织内容，避免把工具成功、管理员权限或旧版利用结果直接当作普遍漏洞。
overview.en: Exchange ProxyToken Authorization Regression focuses on this boundary: Reviews exact version, patches, and front-end or backend authorization responses without forging X-Client Application or granting mailbox permissions. The reviewed entry preserves the original technical capability and organizes it around lab authorization, execution prerequisites, blue-team evidence, and remediation regression so tool success, administrator access, or old exploit results are not treated as universal vulnerabilities.

vulnerability.zh: Exchange 风险必须绑定精确产品版本、累积更新、安全更新、启用角色和前后端路由。公开端点、HTTP 状态或产品名称不能证明 ProxyLogon、ProxyShell 或 ProxyToken；必须有补丁前置条件和服务端授权差异。
vulnerability.en: Exchange 风险必须绑定精确产品版本、累积更新、安全更新、启用角色和前后端路由。公开端点、HTTP 状态或产品名称不能证明 ProxyLogon、ProxyShell 或 ProxyToken；必须有补丁前置条件和服务端授权差异。

exploitation.zh: 在隔离 Exchange 实验环境运行 PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE 版本、补丁、端点和无会话响应查询，保存 AdminDisplayVersion、更新清单、IIS/Exchange 日志与请求 ID。不访问邮箱、导出 PST、伪造头、写 WebShell 或执行利用脚本。 原始技术命令仅在隔离实验环境按单条、单目标执行，并同步保存蓝队证据（目标端事件、网络流量和安全产品告警）以证明能力与检测覆盖。
exploitation.en: Run PAYLOADER_EXCHANGE version, patch, endpoint, and no-session response queries in an isolated Exchange lab, preserving Admin Display Version, update inventory, IIS and Exchange logs, and request I Ds. Do not access mailboxes, export PST, forge headers, write web shells, or run exploit scripts. Run retained technique commands one at a time against one target in an isolated lab, preserving blue-team evidence such as target-side events, network traffic, and security-product alerts to prove both capability and detection coverage.

mitigation.zh: 升级到受支持的 Exchange CU 并安装最新安全更新，运行供应商健康检查，限制管理端点与 ECP/PowerShell 暴露，强化 EPA、身份与反向代理规则。对异常 Autodiscover、EWS、MAPI、PowerShell 和邮箱权限变更建立审计。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to a supported Exchange CU and current security update, run vendor health checks, restrict management endpoints and ECP or PowerShell exposure, and strengthen EPA, identity, and reverse-proxy rules. Audit anomalous Autodiscover, EWS, MAPI, PowerShell, and mailbox-permission changes.

overview.en: Exchange Mailbox-Access Boundary Preflight remains an independently reproducible technical-validation card. Original command capability is retained; review only repairs obvious narrative, placeholder, or non-executable fragments and requires isolated authorization, rollback, and blue-team evidence.

vulnerability.zh: Exchange 或 SharePoint 端点、站点、列表和版本元数据的可见性本身不是漏洞。有效发现需要证明当前测试身份读取了超出已批准租户、站点或角色边界的数据，并能与服务端授权决策和审计日志关联。
vulnerability.en: Visibility of Exchange or SharePoint endpoints, sites, lists, and version metadata is not a vulnerability by itself. A valid finding requires proof that the test identity read data beyond its approved tenant, site, or role boundary, correlated with server authorization decisions and audit logs.

exploitation.zh: 先确认身份、范围、回滚点和蓝队采集，再按原始命令逐条执行；把能力结果与资产清单、目录配置、网络流量、端点遥测和服务端日志交叉核对。
exploitation.en: Confirm identity, scope, rollback point, and blue-team collection first, then run the retained commands one at a time; correlate capability results with inventory, directory configuration, network traffic, endpoint telemetry, and server logs.

mitigation.zh: 按租户、站点和邮箱角色实施最小权限，禁用遗留认证，限制 Autodiscover、OAB、REST 和搜索返回字段，并保留管理与读取审计。修复后重放同一只读元数据请求。
mitigation.en: Enforce least privilege by tenant, site, and mailbox role; disable legacy authentication; constrain Autodiscover, OAB, REST, and search fields; and retain administrative and read auditing. Replay the same metadata-only request after remediation.

overview.en: Safe Unattended-Credential File Review remains an independently reproducible technical-validation card. Original command capability is retained; review only repairs obvious narrative, placeholder, or non-executable fragments and requires isolated authorization, rollback, and blue-team evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 无人值守 XML、Sysprep、GPP、部署脚本或连接字符串只有在低权限主体可读且仍包含可用秘密时才形成凭据暴露。文件名、字段名、Base64 或 cpassword 标记本身不能证明存在有效凭据。
vulnerability.en: Unattended XML, Sysprep, Group Policy Preferences, deployment scripts, or connection strings expose credentials only when a low-privilege principal can read a still-usable secret. A filename, field name, Base64 value, or cpassword marker alone does not prove valid credential exposure.

exploitation.zh: 先确认身份、范围、回滚点和蓝队采集，再按原始命令逐条执行；把能力结果与资产清单、目录配置、网络流量、端点遥测和服务端日志交叉核对。

mitigation.zh: 从镜像、部署共享和历史 GPO 中移除秘密，轮换已暴露账号，使用 LAPS、gMSA 或密钥保管服务，限制 Panther 与部署目录 ACL，并对敏感字段和异常读取建立审计。
mitigation.en: Remove secrets from images, deployment shares, and historical GP Os; rotate exposed identities; use LAPS, g MSA, or a secret vault; restrict Panther and deployment-directory AC Ls; and audit sensitive fields and anomalous reads.

opsecTips.zh: 检测到超出授权的写操作、认证尝试、非授权资产或异常请求量时立即停止、回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on writes, authentication attempts, unauthorized assets, or abnormal request volume outside the authorization.

title.zh: 建立Potato 工具能力安全预检前置条件基线
title.en: Establish the Safe Potato-Tool Capability Preflight Prerequisite Baseline

description.zh: 记录 Potato 工具能力安全预检 的当前主体、单一授权资产、组件或工具版本、适用条件、正常基线和停止条件；不把工具存在或查询成功直接判定为漏洞。
description.en: Record the principal, one authorized asset, component or tool version, applicability conditions, normal baseline, and stop conditions for Safe Potato-Tool Capability Preflight; do not treat tool availability or query success as a vulnerability.

title.zh: 运行一条Potato 工具能力安全预检验证命令
title.en: Run One Safe Potato-Tool Capability Preflight Validation Command

description.zh: 只在授权实验中运行 Potato 工具能力安全预检 的第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态，不串联其他动作。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed Safe Potato-Tool Capability Preflight command in the authorized lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state without chaining other actions.

title.zh: 关联Potato 工具能力安全预检权威证据
title.en: Correlate Authoritative Safe Potato-Tool Capability Preflight Evidence

description.zh: 关联当前服务账号、有效令牌权限、OS build、工具支持矩阵、命名管道或 COM/RPC 事件、4688/Sysmon 进程树与最终 Token；账户创建、下载和回连动作必须与最小权限证明分开记录。
description.en: Correlate the service identity, effective token privileges, OS build, tool support matrix, named-pipe or COM or RPC events, 4688 or Sysmon process trees, and resulting token. Record account creation, downloads, and callbacks separately from minimal privilege proof.

title.zh: 修复并回归Potato 工具能力安全预检
title.en: Remediate and Retest Safe Potato-Tool Capability Preflight

description.zh: 完成 Potato 工具能力安全预检 对应的最小权限、补丁或配置修复后，以相同主体和同一条命令回归，确认正常管理能力保留且原证据链不再成立。
description.en: After the least-privilege, patch, or configuration remediation for Safe Potato-Tool Capability Preflight, retest with the same principal and command to confirm legitimate administration remains available and the original evidence chain no longer holds.

overview.zh: Potato 工具能力安全预检 保留为可独立复现的技术验证卡。原始命令能力不被删除；审校只处理明显叙述、占位符或不可执行片段，并要求隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据。
overview.en: Safe Potato-Tool Capability Preflight remains an independently reproducible technical-validation card. Original command capability is retained; review only repairs obvious narrative, placeholder, or non-executable fragments and requires isolated authorization, rollback, and blue-team evidence.

vulnerability.zh: Potato 系列依赖具体的 Token 模拟权限、服务身份、Windows 版本、COM/RPC 或命名管道行为以及补丁状态。存在 SeImpersonatePrivilege 或某个工具二进制并不等于任意版本都可提权。
vulnerability.en: Potato-family techniques depend on specific token-impersonation privileges, service identities, Windows versions, COM or RPC or named-pipe behavior, and patch state. Se Impersonate Privilege or a tool binary does not mean every variant can elevate on every version.

exploitation.zh: 先确认身份、范围、回滚点和蓝队采集，再按原始命令逐条执行；把能力结果与资产清单、目录配置、网络流量、端点遥测和服务端日志交叉核对。
exploitation.en: Confirm identity, scope, rollback point, and blue-team collection first, then run the retained commands one at a time; correlate capability results with inventory, directory configuration, network traffic, endpoint telemetry, and server logs.

mitigation.zh: 移除不需要的 SeImpersonatePrivilege 与 SeAssignPrimaryTokenPrivilege，避免高权限服务向低信任主体暴露可模拟的本地接口，应用系统与 .NET 补丁，并监控异常命名管道、COM/RPC、令牌复制和 SYSTEM 子进程。
mitigation.en: Remove unnecessary Se Impersonate Privilege and Se Assign Primary Token Privilege, prevent privileged services from exposing impersonable local interfaces to low-trust principals, apply OS and .NET patches, and monitor anomalous named pipes, COM or RPC, token duplication, and SYSTEM child processes.
